parts.body: Go to $peasant_villagename$ deliver the goods from the adivasi farm to $peasant_villagername$.
parts.job: uk|Go to $peasant_villagename$ deliver the goods from the adivasi farm to $peasant_villagername$.

parts.body: Deliver goods
Shukriya, $name! Those goods are most welcome! I hope $peasant_villagername$ received you well?
parts.job: uk|Shukriya, $name! Those goods are most welcome! I hope $peasant_villagername$ received you well?

parts.body: May the goddess bless you.
parts.job: uk|May the goddess bless you.

parts.body: Stealing from poor people is no glorious feat.
parts.translation: Крадіжка у бідних людей - безславне діяння.

parts.body: You did not return the goods to $startvillager_villagername$ in time.
parts.translation: Ви не повернули товари до $startvillager_villagername$ вчасно.

parts.body: Deliver the goods from $peasant_villagename$ to $startvillager_villagername$'s farm, $peasant_startvillager_direction$ to the $peasant_startvillager_distance$ of $peasant_villagename$.
parts.job: uk|Deliver the goods from $peasant_villagename$ to $startvillager_villagername$'s farm, $peasant_startvillager_direction$ to the $peasant_startvillager_distance$ of $peasant_villagename$.

parts.body: Jewel delivery
parts.job: uk|Jewel delivery

parts.body: Namaste, $name. I have heard you are trustworthy and a friend of us Indians, and I have a valuable delivery to make. The lovely Rani $rani_villagername$ of $rani_villagename$ has ordered priceless gems from me for some new jewellery. Would you deliver them to her palace? It's $rani_distance$ to the $rani_direction$ from here. You can keep two of the gems as a reward.
parts.job: uk|Namaste, $name. I have heard you are trustworthy and a friend of us Indians, and I have a valuable delivery to make. The lovely Rani $rani_villagername$ of $rani_villagename$ has ordered priceless gems from me for some new jewellery. Would you deliver them to her palace? It's $rani_distance$ to the $rani_direction$ from here. You can keep two of the gems as a reward.

parts.body: Do not show anyone else those diamonds! I don't want them getting stolen.
parts.translation: Тільки не показуй нікому ці діаманти!

parts.body: Too dangerous for you, I believe?
parts.translation: Занадто небезпечно для тебе, так розуміти?

parts.body: Deliver diamonds
At last. I was getting impatient. $startvillager_villagername$ wouldn't like to see me angry.
parts.job: uk|At last. I was getting impatient. $startvillager_villagername$ wouldn't like to see me angry.

parts.body: I shall go and try those out!
You will end up crushed by one of the Raja's elephants!
parts.translation: Ти закінчиш розчавленим одним з слонів раджі!

parts.body: You did not deliver the diamonds to Rani $rani_villagername$ in time. Your standing amongst Indian villages is much lowered.
parts.job: uk|You did not deliver the diamonds to Rani $rani_villagername$ in time. Your standing amongst Indian villages is much lowered.

parts.body: Deliver the diamonds from the trader $startvillager_villagername$ to Rani $rani_villagername$ of $rani_villagename$.
parts.job: uk|Deliver the diamonds from the trader $startvillager_villagername$ to Rani $rani_villagername$ of $rani_villagename$.

parts.body: Sick Child
parts.job: uk|Sick Child

parts.body: My son $child_villagername$ has been pale lately. He claims he cannot eat one more mouthful of boudin or tripes! Would you have anything to suggest? You look well-travelled.
parts.job: uk|My son $child_villagername$ has been pale lately. He claims he cannot eat one more mouthful of boudin or tripes! Would you have anything to suggest? You look well-travelled.

parts.body: That sweet is delicious! I think I'll eat it myself.
parts.translation: Ця солодкість чудова! Якби не дитина, сама б з'їла.

parts.body: I'll try calva. After that everything works.
Frustrated Lumberman
parts.job: uk|Frustrated Lumberman

parts.body: This axe is useless. Why is no Maya artisan capable of making a really good axe? I would be so much more productive with decent tools!
parts.translation: Цей сокиру даремний. Чому ремісники майя не здатні зробити по-справжньому хороший сокиру? Я був би набагато більш продуктивний з гідним інструментом!

parts.body: That axe feels magical! Was it made by a God?
parts.translation: В це сокирі відчувається магія! Вона зроблена Богом?

parts.body: Back to work then.
Lost Tapestry
parts.job: uk|Lost Tapestry

parts.body: Hello $name! I found a tapestry lying in the fields. Can you find whom it belongs to?
parts.job: uk|Hello $name! I found a tapestry lying in the fields. Can you find whom it belongs to?

parts.body: Thank you $name!
parts.job: uk|Thank you $name!

parts.body: You are horrible! I'm telling my mother on you!
parts.translation: Ви жахливий! Я поскаржуся на тебе своїй мамі!

parts.body: Missing Tapestry
parts.job: uk|Missing Tapestry

parts.body: I have lost a tapestry! Has nobody seen it?
parts.translation: Я втратила гобелен! Ніхто його не бачив?

parts.body: Thank you for finding it.
You're hiding something, I know it.
parts.translation: Ви що то ховаєте, я точно це знаю.

parts.body: Find to whom the tapestry belongs.
parts.job: uk|Find to whom the tapestry belongs.

parts.body: Missing Friend

A friend of mine named $miner_villagername$ usually visits me at the same time every day. The strange thing is that he hasn't been by today at all -- he's several hours late, in fact. I admit, I am a little worried, $name. $miner_villagername$ spends a lot of time over by the mine, and I'm sure you know how dangerous it is there. If you happen to be going that way, though, will you keep an eye out for him?
parts.job: uk|A friend of mine named $miner_villagername$ usually visits me at the same time every day. The strange thing is that he hasn't been by today at all -- he's several hours late, in fact. I admit, I am a little worried, $name. $miner_villagername$ spends a lot of time over by the mine, and I'm sure you know how dangerous it is there. If you happen to be going that way, though, will you keep an eye out for him?

parts.body: Thank you my friend!
I'm sure he will turn up somewhere.
parts.translation: Я сподіваюся що він коли-небудь повернеться.

parts.body: I'm so glad you found me.
parts.translation: Я так радий що ти відшукав мене.

parts.body: Ughhh... A spider bit me very badly while I was exploring the cave very close to here. I am sure I have been seriously poisoned; you must help me. Please tell my wife $wife_villagername$. She will be able to help me.
parts.job: uk|Ughhh... A spider bit me very badly while I was exploring the cave very close to here. I am sure I have been seriously poisoned; you must help me. Please tell my wife $wife_villagername$. She will be able to help me.

parts.body: Hurry... I'm so dizzy...
parts.job: uk|Hurry... I'm so dizzy...

parts.body: You can't just leave me here! Urghh.
parts.job: uk|You can't just leave me here! Urghh.

parts.body: Find $miner_villagername$ over by the mine.
parts.job: uk|Find $miner_villagername$ over by the mine.

parts.body: Making the antidote.
parts.job: uk|Making the antidote.

parts.body: There is no time to lose to save my husband! I know of an antidote that should help with the poison. It requires some ingredients, though, before I can make it. I'll need two brown mushrooms, two red mushrooms, and some squid ink.
parts.translation: Не можна втрачати час, треба рятувати муженька! Мені відомо протиотруту, яке повинно допомогти. Звичайно, воно вимагає деяких інгредієнтів, перш ніж я зможу його приготувати. Мені потрібні два коричневих гриба, два червоних гриба і чорнильний мішок кальмара.

parts.body: Speed be with you, $name.
parts.job: uk|Speed be with you, $name.

parts.body: Fine, I'll take it myself!
parts.translation: Прекрасно, ось тепер шукати все це самій! Бідний мій чоловік.

parts.body: Ask $wife_villagername$ for an antidote.
parts.job: uk|Ask $wife_villagername$ for an antidote.

parts.body: $miner_villagername$'s Antidote
parts.job: uk|$miner_villagername$'s Antidote

parts.body: Bring $miner_villagername$'s Antidote to $miner_villagername$ before the time limit is up.
parts.job: uk|Bring $miner_villagername$'s Antidote to $miner_villagername$ before the time limit is up.

parts.body: Oh, I knew $wife_villagername$ would be able to help me! <$miner_villagername$ drinks the antidote.> I'm always getting into trouble and $wife_villagername$, well, she always manages to help me out of it.
parts.job: uk|Oh, I knew $wife_villagername$ would be able to help me! <$miner_villagername$ drinks the antidote.> I'm always getting into trouble and $wife_villagername$, well, she always manages to help me out of it.

parts.body: Do you want me to die?
You did not bring $miner_villagername$'s Antidote to $miner_villagername$ in time.
parts.job: uk|You did not bring $miner_villagername$'s Antidote to $miner_villagername$ in time.

parts.body: Take $miner_villagername$'s Antidote to $miner_villagername$.
parts.job: uk|Take $miner_villagername$'s Antidote to $miner_villagername$.

parts.body: Find the eggs
parts.job: uk|Find the eggs

parts.body: There are too many chickens around here!. To stop them breeding we need to collect their eggs... Would you help?
parts.translation: Тут так багато курей розплодилося!. Щоб їх плоди не так багато, ми повинні зібрати їх яйця ... Допоможеш?

parts.body: Very good, $name. I will be sending this egg home where I hope it will soon hatch! Please accept this as a symbol of my gratitude.
parts.job: uk|Very good, $name. I will be sending this egg home where I hope it will soon hatch! Please accept this as a symbol of my gratitude.

parts.body: Come back when you have more eggs for me!
parts.translation: Приходь, коли у тебе буде побільше яєць!

parts.body: More feathers
My wife makes pillows for us poor folk. To make them we need lots and lots of feathers. Would you have any you could spare?
parts.translation: Моя дружина робить подушки для нас, бідняків. Але для того щоб їх зробити потрібно багато пір'я. Чи немає у тебе пір'я, щоб поділитися зі мною?

parts.body: Very good, $name. I will be giving these to my wife. You have my thanks.
parts.job: uk|Very good, $name. I will be giving these to my wife. You have my thanks.

parts.body: Back to the wooden pillow then.
Strange reports
My wife has received reports from the villagers that the water from the well is making our kids unwell. Take this bucket and return a sample of water to me.
parts.translation: До моєї дружини дійшли чутки від сусідів ніби вода в колодязі робить наших дітей нездоровими. Візьми це відро і принеси мені на пробу води.

parts.body: Hurry... before other kids become ill.
parts.translation: Поквапся ... поки не захворіли інші діти.

parts.body: I must warn you, what I ask of you next will be very dangerous.
parts.translation: Мушу тебе попередити, що невиконання моїх прохань загрожує.

parts.body: Water sample
parts.job: uk|Water sample

parts.body: Did you bring the water sample ?
Thank you! This will help me find the source of our problems.
parts.translation: Дякую тобі! Це мені допоможе знайти джерело наших проблем.

parts.body: I must warn you, the next time you want help it's going to cost you, $name!
parts.job: uk|I must warn you, the next time you want help it's going to cost you, $name!

parts.body: You did not bring $startvillager_villagername$'s water sample to him in time.
parts.job: uk|You did not bring $startvillager_villagername$'s water sample to him in time.

parts.body: $startvillager_villagername$ at $startvillager_villagename$ wants you to bring him a water sample.
parts.job: uk|$startvillager_villagername$ at $startvillager_villagename$ wants you to bring him a water sample.

parts.body: Broken Sword
parts.job: uk|Broken Sword

parts.body: My husband $knight_villagername$ has broken his sword again! Could you please give this new sword to him?
parts.job: uk|My husband $knight_villagername$ has broken his sword again! Could you please give this new sword to him?

parts.body: Thank you my good man!
You are really not the helpful kind.
Lost Sword
parts.job: uk|Lost Sword

parts.body: My wife $startvillager_villagename$ has a sword for me. Did you bring it?
parts.job: uk|My wife $startvillager_villagename$ has a sword for me. Did you bring it?

parts.body: Thank you, you have saved the day again.
parts.translation: Дякую вам, ви врятували мені день.

parts.body: How do you expect me to help you fight if I don't have a sword?
parts.translation: Ну і як же я буду допомагати вам воювати, якщо я не отримаю меч?

parts.body: You did not deliver the sword on time to $knight_villagername$. The villagers will never forget.
parts.job: uk|You did not deliver the sword on time to $knight_villagername$. The villagers will never forget.

parts.body: $startvillager_villagername$ at $startvillager_villagename$ wants you to bring him his new sword.
parts.job: uk|$startvillager_villagername$ at $startvillager_villagename$ wants you to bring him his new sword.

parts.body: Cousin's birthday
parts.job: uk|Cousin's birthday

parts.body: My young cousin $girl_villagername$ has her birthday today. Will you take this cake to her please?
parts.job: uk|My young cousin $girl_villagername$ has her birthday today. Will you take this cake to her please?

parts.body: Thank you for your help.
That's not very nice of you!
parts.translation: А ти не такий хороший, як мені здалося!

parts.body: [Deliver cake]
parts.job: uk|[Deliver cake]

parts.body: Nobody is celebrating my birthday...
parts.translation: Ніхто навіть і не пам'ятає про мій день народження ...

parts.body: Thank you! Thank you! Thank you!
parts.job: uk|Thank you! Thank you! Thank you!

parts.body: Nobody likes me.
Deliver a cake to $girl_villagername$ at $startvillager_villagename$ for her birthday.
parts.job: uk|Deliver a cake to $girl_villagername$ at $startvillager_villagename$ for her birthday.

parts.body: Fishing Frenzy
Hello there, my name is $startvillager_villagername$. Fishing is time consuming work, and I don't know if I will be able to meet my quota for today. Do you think I could get you to help me?
parts.job: uk|Hello there, my name is $startvillager_villagername$. Fishing is time consuming work, and I don't know if I will be able to meet my quota for today. Do you think I could get you to help me?

parts.body: Thank you, four raw fish should be enough. Return them to my wife, she will repay you.
parts.translation: Дякуємо вам, чотирьох свіжих рибин буде достатньо. Віднесіть їх потім моїй дружині, вона з вами розплатиться.

parts.body: I understand, we are all busy now days.
parts.translation: Я розумію, всі ми зайняті тією чи іншою справою.

parts.body: Fishing Frenzy
Ah you must be the traveller $startvillager_villagername$ told me about. Have you caught the fish?
parts.job: uk|Ah you must be the traveller $startvillager_villagername$ told me about. Have you caught the fish?

parts.body: Wonderful, these are fine looking fish. The rest of the village shall be thankful as well.
parts.translation: Прекрасно, ця риба відмінно виглядає. Все наше поселення дуже вдячно тобі.

parts.body: Not an apt fisher eh? Oh well, you may still be useful for something.
parts.translation: Не вмієш рибалити, так? Ну ладно, може ти вмієш робити що-небудь інше.

parts.body: You could not catch the fish in time. The villagers of $startvillager_villagename$ have noted your disgrace.
parts.job: uk|You could not catch the fish in time. The villagers of $startvillager_villagename$ have noted your disgrace.

parts.body: Catch four fishes and bring them to $wife_villagername$
parts.job: uk|Catch four fishes and bring them to $wife_villagername$

parts.body: Writing Poems
parts.job: uk|Writing Poems

parts.body: Could you help me, $name?<ret>I am missing my friends and family in the capital. We always enjoy writing poems and letters to each other. I hope for the day when we can write to each others again. When that day comes, I would like to be prepared.<ret>Could you gather some bits and pieces for me?
parts.job: uk|Could you help me, $name?<ret>I am missing my friends and family in the capital. We always enjoy writing poems and letters to each other. I hope for the day when we can write to each others again. When that day comes, I would like to be prepared.<ret>Could you gather some bits and pieces for me?

parts.body: I would need ten papers and two each of black, yellow and red dyes.
parts.job: uk|I would need ten papers and two each of black, yellow and red dyes.

parts.body: Arigatou gozaimasu! Thank you very much!<ret>You are honourable to help me like this. Here is my grateful reward.
parts.job: uk|Arigatou gozaimasu! Thank you very much!<ret>You are honourable to help me like this. Here is my grateful reward.

parts.body: I will write a poem on the selfishness of men.
parts.job: uk|I will write a poem on the selfishness of men.

parts.body: Aspiring Trader
parts.job: uk|Aspiring Trader

parts.body: Hey! Are you a trader...? Looking for a good deal? <ret>It's hard making a living being a trader. Buy it low and sell it high. Hahaha!<ret>And yet, a farmer gets more respect than me. But I have new plans to trade with other villages, dealing in luxury goods! I just lack a starting stock.<ret><ret>I would need two diamonds and eight gold bars. Could you sell me that?
parts.job: uk|Hey! Are you a trader...? Looking for a good deal? <ret>It's hard making a living being a trader. Buy it low and sell it high. Hahaha!<ret>And yet, a farmer gets more respect than me. But I have new plans to trade with other villages, dealing in luxury goods! I just lack a starting stock.<ret><ret>I would need two diamonds and eight gold bars. Could you sell me that?

parts.body: Good, very good... This will work nice for my plans. Doumo arigatou! Many thanks!
parts.job: uk|Good, very good... This will work nice for my plans. Doumo arigatou! Many thanks!

parts.body: You have no talent for trade!
parts.job: uk|You have no talent for trade!

parts.body: Husband's lunch
My husband $architect_villagername$ the architect is starving and I forgot to pack food for him! Could you please take him this fish?
parts.job: uk|My husband $architect_villagername$ the architect is starving and I forgot to pack food for him! Could you please take him this fish?

parts.body: Thank you my good man!
You are really not the helpful kind.
Hungry!
parts.job: uk|Hungry!

parts.body: My wife forgot my meal again! Ah, women!
parts.translation: Моя дружина знову забула покласти мені їжу! Ах, жінки!

parts.body: That was awfully kind of you.
parts.job: uk|That was awfully kind of you.

parts.body: Never trust a stranger.
You did not deliver the meal on time. The villagers of $architect_villagename$ won't forget.
parts.job: uk|You did not deliver the meal on time. The villagers of $architect_villagename$ won't forget.

parts.body: Give $architect_villagername$ in village $architect_villagename$ his lunch.
parts.job: uk|Give $architect_villagername$ in village $architect_villagename$ his lunch.

parts.body: Thirsty!
parts.job: uk|Thirsty!

parts.body: Chopping wood is such hard work... If only someone would bring me a bottle of wine!
parts.translation: Рубати дрова дуже важка робота ... От би хтось приніс мені пляшечку вина!

parts.body: Ah, I needed that! Thank you so much, my good man!
parts.translation: Ах, як же мені її не вистачало! Спасибі тобі, добрий чоловіче!

parts.body: Don't count on me next time you need some wood!
parts.job: uk|Don't count on me next time you need some wood!

parts.body: The Hunt
parts.job: uk|The Hunt

parts.body: Hey, you! Our hunters are wanting to go on a Hunt in order to replenish supplies but we are low on materials, can you help us out?
parts.job: uk|Hey, you! Our hunters are wanting to go on a Hunt in order to replenish supplies but we are low on materials, can you help us out?

parts.body: Thank you, for our Hunt we are short about 4 bows and 8 leather, can you get us those?
parts.job: uk|Thank you, for our Hunt we are short about 4 bows and 8 leather, can you get us those?

parts.body: I guess we will have to do without.
parts.job: uk|I guess we will have to do without.

parts.body: Return With the Spoils
parts.job: uk|Return With the Spoils

parts.body: How was the hunt?
parts.job: uk|How was the hunt?

parts.body: Ah! Wonderful! We're very thankful that you decided to help us out. Our hunters will be able to bring back a feast!
parts.job: uk|Ah! Wonderful! We're very thankful that you decided to help us out. Our hunters will be able to bring back a feast!

parts.body: That's disappointing, but I suppose you might get better in time.
parts.job: uk|That's disappointing, but I suppose you might get better in time.

parts.body: You could not aid the community in time. The villagers of $startvillager_villagename$ have noted your disgrace.
parts.job: uk|You could not aid the community in time. The villagers of $startvillager_villagename$ have noted your disgrace.

parts.body: Give $startvillager_villagername$ 4 bows and 8 leather so they can start the Hunt.
parts.job: uk|Give $startvillager_villagername$ 4 bows and 8 leather so they can start the Hunt.

parts.body: The Shadow-People
parts.job: uk|The Shadow-People

parts.body: Brave warrior, we've noticed an unusually high number of what we believe are Shadow-People rightfully cursed by Sedna. They are of course very strong and hard to defend against but we've seen they drop these strange orbs when we defeat them, can you help us collect these?
parts.job: uk|Brave warrior, we've noticed an unusually high number of what we believe are Shadow-People rightfully cursed by Sedna. They are of course very strong and hard to defend against but we've seen they drop these strange orbs when we defeat them, can you help us collect these?

parts.body: Wonderful! Get right on it, we're counting on you. We've heard locals of this world call them, "Endermen." Bring me back 6 of their orbs so we can further study them.
parts.job: uk|Wonderful! Get right on it, we're counting on you. We've heard locals of this world call them, "Endermen." Bring me back 6 of their orbs so we can further study them.

parts.body: You're going to leave us out here to fend for ourselves?! We'll surely die!
parts.job: uk|You're going to leave us out here to fend for ourselves?! We'll surely die!

parts.body: Return With the Spoils
parts.job: uk|Return With the Spoils

parts.body: Have you dispelled a few of them?
parts.job: uk|Have you dispelled a few of them?

parts.body: Sedna be praised, these orbs have very unusual properties to study, I may need more of these orbs later.
parts.job: uk|Sedna be praised, these orbs have very unusual properties to study, I may need more of these orbs later.

parts.body: This isn't enough orbs, but I guess you tried at least.
parts.job: uk|This isn't enough orbs, but I guess you tried at least.

parts.body: You didn't kill enough Shadow-People in time. Our village of $startvillager_villagename$ grieves at our eventual defeat to them.
parts.job: uk|You didn't kill enough Shadow-People in time. Our village of $startvillager_villagename$ grieves at our eventual defeat to them.

parts.body: Kill enough Endermen to get 6 Ender Pearls and bring them back to $startvillager_villagername$.
parts.job: uk|Kill enough Endermen to get 6 Ender Pearls and bring them back to $startvillager_villagername$.

parts.body: $name, we have known you for a long time now, and you know we trust you as one of us, despite never asking who you were or where you came from. Originally, we thought that you were simply a man from another nation that like us had been carried here on the fateful day where the earth shook and we found ourselves in this strange land, where the seasons never change and the rivers do not flow - someone like those strange men in their stone pyramids, or the white-faced men skilled in the forging of iron.<ret><ret>But we have observed you long, and you are different. You seem to have no memory of an earlier land, and thrive here as if you belonged. And yet we have never met anyone else of your kind.<ret><ret>If you know more than we do and do not want to share it, that is your right. But if - as I suspect - you wonder yourself what strange world you roam and what is your place in it, you need wisdom I do not have. One man only that I have heard of can help you: my old guru, Sadhu Vidya. I have not seen him in many years, but I know he wanders in the forest, choosing tall and strong trees for shelter. When you meet him, convey to him my thanks for the wisdom he shared with me.

parts.body: Initiation

I was expecting you, $name. Villagers visit me to seek advice, and I have been told many times about the stranger without a past that befriends Indian villages and seems at home in this wild world we have all been sent to. You must have been told by some village elder that I would answer your questions. It will not be so easy. My knowledge was great in the old world on the banks of the Holy Ganges, but here I must learn everything anew. If you seek a Guru, you have come in vain.<ret><ret>However... Before I retired to a life of meditation, I was skilled in the knowledge of the natural world. There was not a plant I could not name or use between the Himalayas and the jungles of the south. And while my body has grown frail, my mind is still sharp. Help me study this world and you too will learn much about it. But be warned: not all creatures here are peaceful, and I belive we may face... resistance when exploring this world.

parts.body: Hindu epics

I have reflected long on your misadventures in the forest, and illumination eludes me. Those grotesque caricatures of men are unlike anything I had ever seen in our disappeared world, and I cannot understand their existence of purpose. There are however talks of demons in ancient Hindu epics that could relate to them. My solitary existence prevents me from keeping such expensive parchments, but you should be able to find them in Indian villages.
parts.translation: Я багато роздумував про твоїх поневіряння в лісі, але просвітлення вислизає від мене. Ці гротескні каррікатури людей не схожі на тих людей, що я бачив раніше в нашому зниклому світі, і мені також незрозумілі ні мети, ні призначення їхнього існування. Однак, є розповіді в давньо-індуському епосі, що можуть нам розповісти про все це. Мій самотній спосіб життя зупиняє мене від змісту настільки дорогих пергаментів, але ти зможеш їх знайти в поселеннях хінді.

parts.translation: Знайдіть поселенця гінді, у якого ви зможете позичити книги, потім принесіть їх назад Садху.

parts.body: Speak to the pandit
parts.job: uk|Speak to the pandit

parts.body: So you have met the wise sadhu? You must be honoured to be working under such a holy man!<ret><ret>I will of course give him the books he need right away. You should read them as well. Of course, assuming you are educated enough to read Sanskrit.
parts.translation: Ви зустріли мудрого садху? Ви повинні порахує за честь, що з вами співпрацює настільки святий чоловік! <ret> <ret> Звичайно, я прямо зараз дам для нього книги, про які він просить. Ви повинні їх також прочитати. Звичайно, якщо ви досить темні, щоб читати на санскриті.

parts.body: And convey my regards to the holy sadhu!
parts.translation: І передайте мої побажання здравия святому садху!

parts.body: You dare refuse a task given to you by the Sadhu in person?
parts.translation: Ти насмілюєшся відмовити в завданні даному тобі Садху особисто?

parts.body: Speak to the $startvillager_villagerrole$
parts.job: uk|Speak to the $startvillager_villagerrole$

parts.body: The Sadhu needs the great Hindu epics? It is an honour to let him take the copy I have!
parts.translation: Садху побажав перечитати великий епос гінді? Це честь для мене - дати прочитати йому мій екземпляр! Потім ця книга буде зберігатися як реліквія!

parts.body: And convey my regards to the holy sadhu!
parts.translation: І передайте мої побажання здравия святому садху!

parts.body: You dare refuse a task given to you by the Sadhu in person?
parts.translation: Ти насмілюєшся відмовити в завданні даному тобі Садху особисто?

parts.body: Exploring the desert

The great epics are a source of wisdom, in this world like the old one. Many great heros and gods fought against demons in the old times, and the knowledge of their prowess will surely help protect you against evil in this dark world. I believe I can use this knowledge to protect you, but I will need to fast to purify myself first.<ret><ret>While I prepare myself, I want you to continue your work and gather information on this world's barren wastelands, where humans rarely go. Maybe you will meet less opposition there. Go and explore the first desert you find like you explored the forest.
parts.translation: Великий епос - джерело мудрості і в цьому світі, як і в минулому. Безліч великих героїв і богів билися з демонами в минулі часи, і пізнання в їх майстерності безсумнівно допоможе захистити тебе від зла в цьому темному світі. Я впевнений, що зможу використовувати це знання для захисту твоєї, але перед цим я повинен здійснити очищення. <ret> <ret> І поки я готував, я хочу щоб ти продовжив свої праці і отримав пізнання про безплідних пустках цього світу, де рідко ступає нога людини. Може бути ти зустрінеш менше протидії там. Іди і досліджуй першу пустелю, що зустрінеш, також, як ти осягав лісу.

parts.body: I will fast while you are gone.
parts.translation: Я постараюся встигнути, поки ти осягаєш пустелі.

parts.body: You sadden me, $name.
parts.job: uk|You sadden me, $name.

parts.body: Report findings
I trust the Goddess kept you safe during your exploration.
parts.translation: Я сподіваюся, Богиня зберегла тебе в цілості за час твоїх досліджень.

parts.body: Your description of the desert as "barren" and "sandy" does little to increase our knowledge, $name. But it is interesting that you noticed more of those walking skeletons than previously. The land itself seems to react to you exploring it.<ret><ret>In your absence, I have prayed long and hard, and Vishnu in his infinite widsom chose to bless our quest. He has granted me the knowledge to feel evil around me, and to pour it in this amulet. Take it, and let it protect you.
parts.job: uk|Your description of the desert as "barren" and "sandy" does little to increase our knowledge, $name. But it is interesting that you noticed more of those walking skeletons than previously. The land itself seems to react to you exploring it.<ret><ret>In your absence, I have prayed long and hard, and Vishnu in his infinite widsom chose to bless our quest. He has granted me the knowledge to feel evil around me, and to pour it in this amulet. Take it, and let it protect you.

parts.job: uk|I will stay here and pray you change your mind, $name.

parts.body: Explore a desert at night as indicated by the Sadhu.
parts.translation: Дослідіть пустелю вночі, як вказав Садху.

parts.body: Marsh expert
parts.job: uk|Marsh expert

parts.body: $name, we need to continue gathering information on this world. I believe the marshes to be particularly important places as they seem to be present far more than natural forces would suggest. Thankfully for you, there will be no need to explore them yourself. There are people whose knowledge of them is unmatched: the adivasi farmers. Those men are poor and looked down upon by the villagers, but they are observant and spend their lives deep in the marshes. Find one and ask him for information. Tell him you are coming on my behalf and he will be welcoming.

parts.body: I cannot give you directions to their dwellings, but search the marshes and you should find them.
parts.translation: Я не можу дати тобі напрямки до їхніх осель, але шукай в болотах і ти знайдеш їх.

parts.body: I will stay here and pray you change your mind, $name.
parts.job: uk|I will stay here and pray you change your mind, $name.

parts.body: Bring the samples back
parts.job: uk|Bring the samples back

parts.body: Have the Adivasis shared their knowledge with you?
parts.translation: Поділилися чи аборигени адівазі своїми знаннями з тобою?

parts.body: Excellent, those will be most useful. Has he said anything about abnormal activities in the marshes?
parts.translation: Відмінно, вони будуть дуже корисні. Чи сказали вони про аномальні явища в болотах?

parts.body: You sadden me.
parts.job: uk|You sadden me.

parts.body: Find an adivasi farmer in a marsh and ask him for information on the marshes. Go back to the Sadhu after that.
parts.translation: найдти фермерів-аборигенів у болотах і запитайте у них інформацію про болота. Поверніться потім до Садху.

parts.body: Speak to farmer
parts.job: uk|Speak to farmer

parts.body: The Sadhu himself requests my help? But I am but a poor, ignorant man... What can I give him save for some lowly plants I have collected... I have also seen dark creatures wander in the marshes at night, and some burst into flames when the day comes! I have collected some of the remains of those foul things, maybe the Holy Man can understand what abomination this is?<ret><ret>And I pray you will accept this food before you leave, $name. Whoever works for the Sadhu must be a good man.
parts.job: uk|The Sadhu himself requests my help? But I am but a poor, ignorant man... What can I give him save for some lowly plants I have collected... I have also seen dark creatures wander in the marshes at night, and some burst into flames when the day comes! I have collected some of the remains of those foul things, maybe the Holy Man can understand what abomination this is?<ret><ret>And I pray you will accept this food before you leave, $name. Whoever works for the Sadhu must be a good man.

parts.body: I pray this will be useful to him. His wisdom knows no bound.
parts.translation: Я молюся, що це буде корисно для його досліджень. Його мудрість не знає меж.

parts.body: How can you refuse the holy task of helping the sadhu?
parts.translation: Як ти можеш відмовлятися від священної завдання допомоги садху?

parts.body: Holy Weapon
parts.job: uk|Holy Weapon

parts.body: The adivasi's tales are dark, $name. Even with your amulet, how can you feel safe exploring this land when demons roam freely when the sun is set? I have read again the epics in your absence, and I feel I know what you need: a holy weapon to protect you, something mighty and terrible like the fearsome Sudarshana Chakra wielded by Lord Vishnu himself. But even after three days of fast, my meditation goes unanswered. I fear my knowledge is failing me. $name, your connection to this world is far greater than mine, though we do not understand it - do you believe you could obtain a holy blade to fight off this evil?
parts.job: uk|The adivasi's tales are dark, $name. Even with your amulet, how can you feel safe exploring this land when demons roam freely when the sun is set? I fear my knowledge is failing me. $name, your connection to this world is far greater than mine, though we do not understand it - do you believe you could obtain a holy blade to fight off this evil?

parts.body: May the Gods watch over you, friend.
parts.translation: Нехай боги спостерігають за тобою, друг.

parts.body: I will stay here and pray you change your mind, $name.
parts.job: uk|I will stay here and pray you change your mind, $name.

parts.body: Bring the enchanted blade
parts.job: uk|Bring the enchanted blade

parts.body: So $name, have you be granted a weapon with which to fight those unholy creatures?
parts.job: uk|So $name, have you be granted a weapon with which to fight those unholy creatures?

parts.body: Such power is in you, that you did not request a magical weapon from the Gods, but forged it yourself! Your inborn knowledge of this world frightens me, $name. I sometime wonder if you are just a man. Leave me now. I need to pray for guidance.
parts.job: uk|Such power is in you, that you did not request a magical weapon from the Gods, but forged it yourself! Your inborn knowledge of this world frightens me, $name. I sometime wonder if you are just a man. Leave me now. I need to pray for guidance.

parts.body: Show the Sadhu an enchanted sword.
parts.job: uk|Show the Sadhu an enchanted sword.

parts.body: I will stay here and pray you change your mind, $name.
parts.job: uk|I will stay here and pray you change your mind, $name.

parts.body: Fear and knowledge

Forgive me, my friend. I did not mean to chase you away so brusquely, after all you have done. I should not have let my fear overpower me. I need to understand your powers, not take fright. Will you show me how you crafted this sword of yours?
parts.translation: Прости мене, друже мій. Я не хотів возсилається на тебе гоніння так грубо, особливо після всього того, що ти зробив. Я не повинен був дозволити своєму страху пересилити мій розум. Я повинен зрозуміти твої сили, а не боятися їх. Покажеш ти як ти створив той меч, що у тебе?

parts.body: I thank you.
I will stay here and pray you change your mind, $name.
parts.job: uk|I will stay here and pray you change your mind, $name.

parts.body: Show the enchantment table
So, how did you perform this feat worthy of a god?
parts.translation: І все ж, як ви вчинили це діяння, що гідно бога?

parts.body: A table of obsidian and diamonds, books full of words you cannot decipher, energy gathered from dead demons - and you naturally know how to make it all work, as if by instinct. Someone is guiding you, $name. God or Demon King, I cannot say.
parts.job: uk|A table of obsidian and diamonds, books full of words you cannot decipher, energy gathered from dead demons - and you naturally know how to make it all work, as if by instinct. Someone is guiding you, $name. God or Demon King, I cannot say.

parts.body: Build an enchantment table and at least one bookshelf next it within ten metres of the Sadhu's tree.
parts.translation: Побудуйте стіл зачарования і як мінімум одну книжкову полицю поруч не далі ніж в десяти метрах від дерева Садху.

parts.body: I will stay here and pray you change your mind, $name.
parts.job: uk|I will stay here and pray you change your mind, $name.

parts.body: Exploring mountains

I must study this table you built, and see if I can understand how it works. While I do this, I have a last exploration task for you to do, $name. I need you to study a nearby mountain range. In my meditations, I can almost see a pattern forming, almost...
parts.job: uk|I must study this table you built, and see if I can understand how it works. While I do this, I have a last exploration task for you to do, $name. I need you to study a nearby mountain range. In my meditations, I can almost see a pattern forming, almost...

parts.body: I have no doubts you will come back, now that I understand what power you wield.
parts.translation: У мене немає сумнівів, що до твого повернення я зрозумію що за силою ти володієш.

parts.body: I will stay here and pray you change your mind, $name.
parts.job: uk|I will stay here and pray you change your mind, $name.

parts.body: Report findings
I trust you found the mountains peaceful under the moonlight.
parts.translation: Сподіваюся, ти знайшов гори повними спокою під місячним світлом.

parts.body: So this time it was spiders that troubled your night-time explorations? I have seen those at night, lurking near this tree. But what do they mean? Why are they present even in mountains where they do not fit? It is a worrying sign, creatures that do not belong to the places they roam.
parts.translation: А тепер були павуки, що заважали тобі під час нічних досліджень? Я бачив кількох таких в ночі, переховуються близько цього древа. Але що вони означають? Що вони роблять в горах, де їм не місце? Тривожний знак цей, створення, що бродять у місцях, яким вони не належать.

parts.body: I will stay here and pray you change your mind, $name.
parts.job: uk|I will stay here and pray you change your mind, $name.

parts.body: Explore a mountain range at night as indicated by the Sadhu.
parts.translation: Дослідіть гори вночі, як вказав Садху.

parts.body: The great dive
parts.job: uk|The great dive

parts.body: Last night the Goddess spoke to me and whispered that it is deeper that I should look. I have given it much thought, but I now know what she meant: you must explore the very depth of the sea.
parts.translation: Минулої ночі Богиня говорила зі мною і шепнула, що це глибше ніж я можу побачити. Я довго думав над її словами, і тепер зрозумів що вона мала на увазі: ти повинен досліджувати глибини океану.

parts.body: Dive, my friend, and tell me what lies in the depths.
parts.translation: Пірнай, друже мій, і розкажи мені, що лежить в глибинах океану.

parts.body: I will stay here and pray you change your mind, $name.
parts.job: uk|I will stay here and pray you change your mind, $name.

parts.body: Report findings
So what is there to be seen so deep under the waves?
You say that as deep as you went, there was no sign of life... No fish, and no aquatic plants? This will require much thought on my part.
parts.translation: Кажеш, що на всю глибину що ти пірнув не було ні ознаки життя ... Ні риб, ні підводних рослин? Це зажадає багатьох моїх роздумів.

parts.body: I will stay here and pray you change your mind, $name.
parts.job: uk|I will stay here and pray you change your mind, $name.

parts.body: Dive at least 12 metres below the surface of a sea.
parts.translation: Нирніте як мінімум на 12 метрів у глибину моря.

parts.body: Window in the depth

I have thought long about your report, $name. Maybe you did not see well enough, in your fleeting dives. I need you to go back to the sea and build an observation room as deep as you can, from which to study the depths in peace.
parts.job: uk|I have thought long about your report, $name. Maybe you did not see well enough, in your fleeting dives. I need you to go back to the sea and build an observation room as deep as you can, from which to study the depths in peace.

parts.body: I know this is a challenging project, but I trust the Goddess to inspire you in its fulfilment.
parts.translation: Я знаю, це складний проект, але я вірю, що Богиня надихне тебе в його виконанні.

parts.body: I will stay here and pray you change your mind, $name.
parts.job: uk|I will stay here and pray you change your mind, $name.

parts.body: Report findings
What have you seen, where no man has ever seen?
parts.job: uk|What have you seen, where no man has ever seen?

parts.body: So the bottom of the sea is truly a barren place, devoid of life beyond those mysterious squid. This cannot be... No sea can be so empty, and how could such mighty animals survive without prey? <ret><ret>You have given me much to think about, $name. Come back in a while and I pray I will have answers for you.
parts.job: uk|So the bottom of the sea is truly a barren place, devoid of life beyond those mysterious squid. This cannot be... No sea can be so empty, and how could such mighty animals survive without prey? <ret><ret>You have given me much to think about, $name. Come back in a while and I pray I will have answers for you.

parts.body: I will stay here and pray you change your mind, $name.
parts.job: uk|I will stay here and pray you change your mind, $name.

parts.body: Build an observation room with a glass ceiling at least 15 metres below the surface.
parts.translation: Побудуйте підводну обсерваторію з скляною стелею як мінімум в 15 метрах нижче рівня моря.

parts.body: Knowledge and rituals

While you have explored the sea, I have focused all my thoughts on this mystery you left me - the enchantment table. I have struggled to decipher the books and the secrets of the construction of the table itself, and understood nothing. But wisdom came in my meditations: the table and the books do not matter. A practical man like you need them, a material support for you to focus on. But the power is not in them, it is in you and the world. And there are other ways to harness it.<ret><ret>I believe even a village pandit can do something similar, with proper training. I want you to go to the nearest Indian village and take this parchment to its priest. With the hymns I have written on it, he should be able to pray the gods to bless tools you give him, provided you give him proper offerings for the deities.
parts.translation: Поки ти досліджував море, я сконцентрував всі мої думки на тій загадці, що ти залишив мені - столі зачарования. Я з усіх сил намагався розшифрувати книги і секрет будівництва самого столу, і - нічого не зрозумів. Але мудрість прийшла в моїх медитаціях: стіл і книги не мають значення. Людина матеріалістичних поглядів, як ти, потребуєш них, як матеріальної підтримки для того, щоб ти зміг сфокусуватися. Але сила не в них, сила в тобі і в світі, що оточує тебе. І є інші способи, щоб її використовувати. <ret> <ret> Я впевнений, що навіть пандит, жрець в поселенні, зможе робити щось подібне, якщо він пройде деяку духовну практику. Я хочу щоб ти прийшов найближчим поселення гінді, знайшов там жерця і віддав йому цей пергамент. З мантрами, що написані в ньому, вони зможуть молити богів благословити інструменти, які ти їм даси, за умови, що ти зробиш належні підношення для богів.

parts.body: I could not bring myself to write hymns of war, so he will be limited to blessing tools, not weapons.
parts.translation: Я так і не зміг змусити себе написати мантру війни, тому вони зможуть благославляющего лише інструменти, а не зброя.

parts.body: I will stay here and pray you change your mind, $name.
parts.job: uk|I will stay here and pray you change your mind, $name.

parts.body: Speak with the Sadhu
Did the priest read the hymns?
parts.job: uk|Did the priest read the hymns?

parts.body: I am glad it worked. This will be useful to you, $name, and it is reassuring that we can shape this world in ways that we had not expected.
parts.job: uk|I am glad it worked. This will be useful to you, $name, and it is reassuring that we can shape this world in ways that we had not expected.

parts.body: I will stay here and pray you change your mind, $name.
parts.job: uk|I will stay here and pray you change your mind, $name.

parts.body: Go back to the Sadhu after speaking with the pandit.
parts.translation: Поверніться і поговоріть з Садху після переговорів з жерцем (пандитом).

parts.body: Speak to the pandit
parts.job: uk|Speak to the pandit

parts.body: Why would the Sadhu want me to sing new hymns, when all wisdom is in the old one? If he was not such a holy man I would wonder if he has not stayed too long in the forest. But I will perform pujas with those for you if you want. Come see me in the temple with your offerings, my fee and the tool you want blessed.
parts.translation: Чому Садху бажає щоб я співав нові мантри, якщо вся мудрість у старих? Якби він не був настільки святий, я б запитав - НЕ засидівся він у лісах. Але я буду виконувати пуджа з новими мантрами для тебе, якщо тобі буде потрібно, тільки для Садху. Приходь у храм зі своїми підношеннями, милостинею мені та інструментом для благословіння.

parts.body: Do not forget my fee, if you want me to do pujas for you.
parts.job: uk|Do not forget my fee, if you want me to do pujas for you.

parts.body: How can you refuse the holy task of helping the sadhu?
parts.translation: Як ти можеш відмовлятися від священної завдання допомоги садху?

parts.body: Limits of the world

$name, there is a last challenge I need you to undertake for me. I know from reports of courageous Indian explorers that this new world is vast - in the first few years after the night of fire which took us here, many young Indian villagers travelled far and wide to find known shores again, in vain. They also never saw any mountain that is worthy of that name, something to rival the mighty Himalayas. I have thought hard about it, and this has come to my mind: the sky here looks as high as it ever was over the plains of the Ganges, but the clouds are always low, and never do we see any birds or creature above them. Could it be that everything above them is an illusion? You need to go and see for yourself what is there above the clouds.

parts.body: You may start by climbing the branches of this venerable tree if it helps your undertaking.
parts.translation: Ти можеш почати сходження по гілках цього поважного дерева, якщо це допоможе твоєму підприємству.

parts.body: I will stay here and pray you change your mind, $name.
parts.job: uk|I will stay here and pray you change your mind, $name.

parts.body: Report findings
What have you seen from so far above the earth, $name?
parts.job: uk|What have you seen from so far above the earth, $name?

parts.body: So there is a limit, no further than the height of ninety men above the waters of the sea... Is this world a mockery of the real one then, the work of a demon or a god? $name, you must confirm this finding. You must see if this world is finite downward as well, if this ground we live in is but a thin slice of earth floating on nothingness.
parts.job: uk|So there is a limit, no further than the height of ninety men above the waters of the sea... parts.body: The Book of the Sadhu

I have fasted and prayed for guidance, and the Gods have whispered some wisdom in my ears. But I was not worthy enough to uncover the truth, just to glimpse at aspects of it.<ret><ret>$name, I am too tired to speak now. I have written my findings in this scroll. parts.body: I have written this parchment in the holy language of Sanskrit, which only a few pandits master anymore. But somehow I knew you would be able to understand it. The Goddess whispers in your ear, even if you cannot hear her.

parts.body: I will keep this book until you change your mind.
parts.translation: Я буду зберігати цей сувій, поки ти не передумаєш.

parts.body: Leadership

parts.body: So you prefer to focus on searching for the truth? This is a wise decision. But should you change your mind, come back to me.

parts.body: Relations help<ret><ret>Relations between villages determines whether those villages will cooperate or not.<ret><ret>Local trade (merchants carrying resources) will happen between villages with good relations of the same culture or excellent relations of different cultures.<ret><ret>Villages of different cultures with very good relations that both have markets will host merchants from the other culture.<ret><ret>Villages of the same culture with excellent relations will accept each others' teenagers if they have jobs available.<ret><ret>Relations between villages start at excellent for hamlets of a parent village, good for villages of the same culture, and neutral otherwise.<ret><ret>Each day, a player gets five diplomatic points with which to influence villages' relations. The effectiveness of the praise or slander depends on his reputation in that village.
parts.translation: Допомога про відносини <ret> <ret> Відносини між поселеннями визначає чи будуть дані поселення співпрацювати чи ні. <ret> <ret> Місцевий торговець (купець зберігає ресурси) торгуватиме з поселеннями при хороших відносинах в тій же культурі, або при відмінних відносинах іншої культури. <ret> <ret> Поселення різних культур і дуже хорошими відносинами при наявності ринків будуть відсилати купців своєї культури іншій культурі. <ret> <ret> Поселення тієї ж культури з відмінними відносинами надаватимуть і приймати підлітків, якщо для них є робота. <ret> <ret> Відносини між головними та провідними поселеннями спочатку відмінні, хорошими для поселень тієї ж культури і нейтральними в іншому випадку. <ret> <ret> Кожен день гравець отримує 5 очок дипломатії, якими може впливати на відносини між поселеннями. Ефективність хвали, або лайки залежить від його репутації в даному поселенні.

parts.body: Generalities on Trading

In each store you can buy goods that the village has in stock. Apart from a few "free" blocks (such as paths) or special items (the wands), the proposed goods were produced by the village and the village"loses" the items if you buy them, unlike when trading with Minecraft villages.<ret><ret>Villagers produce most of the goods they need, but selling some to them often helps accelerate the development of the village.
parts.job: uk|In each store you can buy goods that the village has in stock. Apart from a few "free" blocks (such as paths) or special items (the wands), the proposed goods were produced by the village and the village"loses" the items if you buy them, unlike when trading with Minecraft villages.<ret><ret>Villagers produce most of the goods they need, but selling some to them often helps accelerate the development of the village.

parts.body: These types of blocks are made for "free" by the village and are therefore available in unlimited quantities.
parts.translation: Ці типи блоків виготовляються "безкоштовно" (створюються без використання ресурсів) в селі і тому доступні в необмеженій кількості.

parts.body: The villagers produce wood in groves. They use it to build.
parts.translation: Жителі села рубають деревину в гаях. Вони використовують її для будівлі.

parts.body: The villagers produce stone and glass in quarries. If the village does not have one, it is entirely dependent on you for their needs.
parts.translation: Жителі села добувають камінь і скло в кар'єрах. Якщо село не має жодного кар'єра, вона повністю залежить від ваших поставок.

parts.body: White wool is used in some buildings. The villagers dye it automatically if necessary.
parts.translation: Біла шерсть використовується в деяких будівлях. Жителі села пофарбують її автоматично при необхідності.

parts.body: The villagers produce bricks with clay from quarries.
parts.translation: Жителі села виробляють цеглу і глину в кар'єрах.

parts.body: Access to different types of food helps children grow faster.
parts.translation: Наявність різних продуктів допомагає дітям рости швидше.

parts.body: The villagers cook meat before eating it.
Alcohol and sweets help increase the villagers' chances of conceiving children.
parts.translation: Алкоголь і солодощі допомагають жителям збільшити шанси завести дітей.

parts.body: The villagers use seeds to plant wheat and feed chickens.
parts.translation: Жителі використовують насіння пшениці щоб годувати курей

parts.body: Villagers use carrots to feed their pigs.
parts.translation: Жителі використовують моркву, щоб прогодувати свиней.

parts.body: Feathers are used to make arrows.
Tools of different levels make villagers more effective.
Weapons and armour of different levels make villagers more powerful.
parts.translation: Зброя і обладунки роблять жителі сильнішими.

parts.body: Bourses à deniers can store deniers and keep track of your funds. They are always available.
parts.translation: Мещочек з грошима допоможе зберігати Ваші денье.

parts.body: The wand of summoning allows you to create villages. They are always available.
parts.translation: Жезл Створення дозволяє створювати села і будувати будинки.

parts.body: Parchments provide information about Millénaire. They are always available.
White wool is used in some buildings and is needed to make tapestries in Norman forts.
parts.translation: Біла шерсть використовується в деяких будівлях і потрібна щоб зробити гобелени в фортах Норман.

parts.body: Grey, light grey, black, and brown wools are required by the lady to make tapestries.
parts.translation: Сіра, світло-сіра, чорна, коричнева шерсть необхідні щоб ткати гобелени.

parts.body: Norman monks use leather to make books.
parts.translation: Норманський ченці використовують шкіру, щоб зробити книги.

parts.body: Norman smiths use iron to make Norman weapons and tools of exceptional quality.
parts.translation: Норманський ковалі використовують залізо щоб зробити зброю та інструменти виняткової якості.

parts.body: Norman monks produce bookshelves with paper and books. They are used in some buildings.
parts.translation: Норманський ченці виробляють книжкові полиці з паперу і книг. Вони використовуються в деяких будівлях.

parts.body: The alchemist produces basic potions.

Normans produce cider and calva in taverns from cider apples harvested by loggers. These drinks heal and regenerate the player and help the villagers to have children. Calva also provides a temporary "Strength" bonus.
parts.translation: Нормани виробляють Сидр і Кальву в тавернах з "яблук для сидру" збираються лісорубом. Ці напої зцілюють гравця і допомагають сільським жителям мати дітей. Кальва також забезпечує тимчасовий бонус "Сили".

parts.body: Normans produce tripes and boudins from cows and pigs. These foods nourish the player and help children grow. Tripes also provide a temporary "Regeneration" bonus.
parts.translation: Нормани виробляють Рубець та ковбаски з корів і свиней. Ці продукти живлять гравця і допомагають дітям рости швидше. Рубець також забезпечує тимчасовий бонус "Регенерации".

parts.body: Ladies produce these decorative tapestries from white, grey, light grey, brown, and black wool.
parts.translation: Дами виробляють ці декоративні гобелени з білої, сірої, світло-сірої, коричневої і чорної шерсті.

parts.body: Norman carpenters produce these timber frames from wood.
parts.translation: Норманський теслі виробляють ці каркаси з дерева.

parts.body: Norman villagers make bread and feed their livestock with wheat.
parts.translation: Норманський жителі роблять хліб і годують свою худобу пшеницею.

parts.body: Byzantine smiths use iron and leather to produce iron tools and Byzantine armours.
parts.translation: Візантійські ковалі використовують залізо і шкіру для виробництва знарядь праці і візантійських обладунків.

parts.body: The Byzantines produce feta cheeses from sheep milk. These cheeses heal and regenerate the player and help the villagers to have children.
parts.translation: Візантійці виробляють сир фета з овечого молока. Ці сири зцілюють гравця і допомагають сільським жителям мати дітей.

parts.body: The Byzantines produce books from wood and leather.
parts.translation: Візантійці виробляють книги з дерева і шкіри.

parts.body: The Byzantines produce wine from grapes in taverns. The wine heals the player and helps the villagers have children. It also provides a temporary "Resistance" bonus.
parts.translation: Візантійці виробляють вино з винограду в тавернах. Вино лікує гравця і допомагає жителям мати дітей. Воно також забезпечує тимчасовий бонус "Опору".

parts.body: The Byzantine produce silk and use it to make paintings, icons, and luxurious clothes for the rich Byzantines.
parts.translation: Візантійці виробляють шовк і використовують його для створення картин, ікон і розкішного одягу для багатих греків.

parts.body: The Byzantines produce clothing from wool and silk. They improve the appearance of the villagers who wear them.
parts.translation: Візантійці виробляють одяг з вовни та шовку. Вона покращує зовнішній вигляд жителів, які її носять.

parts.body: The Byzantines produce tiles from stone and clay.
parts.job: uk|The Byzantines produce tiles from stone and clay.

parts.body: The Byzantines cook the lamb chops and mix them with their feta cheeses to make delicious souvlakis. These foods nourish the player and help children grow. Souvlakis also give back health.
parts.translation: Візантійці готують баранячі відбивні і змішують їх з сиром фета, щоб зробити смачні Шашлички. Шашлички живлять гравця і допомагають дітям рости. Вони також відновлюють здоров'я.

parts.body: Byzantine blacksmiths produce solid, formidable armour from iron and leather.
parts.translation: Візантійські ковалі створюють броню з заліза і шкіри.

parts.body: The Byzantine villagers make bread and feed their livestock with wheat.
parts.translation: Візантійські жителі роблять хліб і годують свою худобу пшеницею.

parts.body: Indian smiths use iron to produce tools and armour.
parts.job: uk|Indian smiths use iron to produce tools and armour.

parts.body: Access to different types of food helps children grow faster. Warning: Indians do not eat beef or pork.
parts.job: uk|Access to different types of food helps children grow faster. Warning: Indians do not eat beef or pork.

parts.body: Desserts increase help villagers conceive children. Warning: Indian villagers do not drink alcohol.
parts.job: uk|Desserts increase help villagers conceive children. Warning: Indian villagers do not drink alcohol.

parts.body: The Indians produce delicious rasgullas from sugar. They heal and regenerate the player and help villagers have children. They also provides a temporary "Speed" bonus.
parts.job: uk|The Indians produce delicious rasgullas from sugar. They heal and regenerate the player and help villagers have children. They also provides a temporary "Speed" bonus.

parts.body: The Indians cook vegetarian curries with rice and turmeric as well as chicken curries by adding a chicken. These foods nourish the player and help children grow. Chicken curries also provides a temporary "Fire resistance" bonus.
parts.job: uk|The Indians cook vegetarian curries with rice and turmeric as well as chicken curries by adding a chicken. These foods nourish the player and help children grow. Chicken curries also provides a temporary "Fire resistance" bonus.

parts.body: The Indians leave wet mud bricks in the sun to cook to make dry bricks. You can make them yourself by buying a mould.
parts.job: uk|The Indians leave wet mud bricks in the sun to cook to make dry bricks. You can make them yourself by buying a mould.

parts.body: Indian sculptors produce these bas-relief of Hindu gods for adorning Indian temples.
parts.job: uk|Indian sculptors produce these bas-relief of Hindu gods for adorning Indian temples.

parts.body: The Japanese use gold to decorate some buildings.
parts.translation: Японці використовують золото для прикраси деяких будівель.

parts.body: The Japanese cook udons from wheat and chicken. They nourish the player and help children grow.
parts.translation: Японці варять Удон з пшениці та курки. Він годує гравця і допомагає дітям рости швидше. Удон також надає тимчасовий бонус "Високого стрибка".

parts.body: Japanese smiths use iron and leather to produce iron tools and Japanese armour.
parts.translation: Японські ковалі використовують залізо і шкіру для виробництва знарядь праці та японської броні.

parts.body: Japanese blacksmiths produce beautiful armour and formidable swords from iron, leather, and wool.
parts.translation: Японські ковалі створюють гарні обладунки та грізні мечі з заліза, шкіри та вовни.

parts.body: Japanese artisans produce paper from rice and use it to make translucent walls.
parts.translation: Японські майстри виробляють папір з рису і використовують її для створення паперових стін.

parts.body: Japanese craftsmen produce timber frames from wood to build elegant buildings.
parts.translation: Японські майстри виробляють каркаси з дерева для створення елегантних будівель.

parts.body: The Japanese use rice to grow and nourish their children, to produce paper, and to ferment sake.
parts.translation: Японський рис використовується для годування дітей, для виробництва паперу, а також для бродіння саке.

parts.body: The Japanese cook wheat to make udons.
parts.translation: Японський кухар використовує пшеницю, щоб зробити Удон.

parts.body: Japanese produce blocks from wheat.
Japanese sake brewers use rice to brew sake. Sake heals and regenerates the player and helps the villagers have children. It also provides a temporary "Jump Boost" bonus.
parts.translation: Японські пивовари використовують рис щоб варити саке. Саке лікує гравця і допомагає жителям села мати дітей. Саке також забезпечує тимчасовий бонус "Підводне дихання".

parts.body: The Japanse raise squids and grill them to make ikayakis. They nourish the player and help children grow. They also provide a temporary "Water Breathing" bonus.
parts.job: uk|The Japanse raise squids and grill them to make ikayakis. They nourish the player and help children grow. They also provide a temporary "Water Breathing" bonus.

parts.body: Maya artisans need gold to produce decorative blocks. They require players to provide the gold for them.
parts.translation: Ремісникам Майя потрібно золото для виробництва декоративних блоків. Вони отримують його від гравця.

parts.body: The Maya people grow corn and make masa (maize tortillas) and wah (by adding chicken) from it. They nourish the player and help children grow. Wah also provide a temporary "Haste" bonus.
parts.translation: Народ майя вирощують кукурудзу і готує Маса (кукурудзяні коржі) і Вах (шляхом додавання курка) з неї. Вони живлять гравця і допомагають дітям рости швидше. Вах також забезпечити тимчасовий бонус "Поспіх".

parts.body: Maya artisans produce tools with obsidian sold by the player. These tools are not very effective, but can be enchanted easily.
parts.translation: Майстри Майя виробляють інструменти з обсидіану проданого гравцем. Ці інструменти не дуже ефективні, але можуть бути легко зачаровані.

parts.body: Maya artisans produce tools and swords from stone as basic tools in the absence of obsidian.
parts.translation: Майстри Майя виробляють інструменти та мечі з каменю в якості основних інструментів у відсутність обсидіану.

parts.body: Maya artisans make stone swords and leather armour. Obsidian craftsmen can make them more powerful and very enchantable obsidian maces.
parts.translation: Ремісники Майя роблять кам'яні мечі та шкіряні обладунки. Майстри обсидіану можуть зробити їх більш потужними.

parts.body: Maya cocoa farmers harvest cocoa pods and use them to prepare cacauhaa, a chocolate drink. Cacauhaa heals and regenerate the player and helps increase the number of villagers who will have children. It also provides a temporary "Night Vision" bonus.
parts.translation: Фермери Майя збирають урожай какао і використовують їх для підготовки Какауха, шоколадний напій. Какауха зцілює гравця і допомагає збільшити кількість сільських жителів, які будуть мати дітей. Какауха також забезпечує тимчасовий бонус "Нічного бачення".

parts.body: Inuit use spades to sod coarse dirt into planks to make sure the planks are fully sealed and will keep warmth in.
parts.job: uk|Inuit use spades to sod coarse dirt into planks to make sure the planks are fully sealed and will keep warmth in.

parts.body: Leather is used by vaious cultures to help produce tools, armor, and other things.
parts.job: uk|Leather is used by vaious cultures to help produce tools, armor, and other things.

parts.body: Furriers produce special armor to help protect against the elements and are protected by helpful spirits.
parts.job: uk|Furriers produce special armor to help protect against the elements and are protected by helpful spirits.

parts.body: Though the Inuit find raw foods quite tasty, these can be cooked in various ways to make them more nutritious.
parts.job: uk|Though the Inuit find raw foods quite tasty, these can be cooked in various ways to make them more nutritious.

parts.body: Specially prepared food that can satiate in much better ways than its raw form.
parts.job: uk|Specially prepared food that can satiate in much better ways than its raw form.

parts.body: The Inuit can produce items from nature to better suit their general housing needs.
parts.job: uk|The Inuit can produce items from nature to better suit their general housing needs.

parts.prefix: v1;0;I sodeia ton sitiron paei kala fetos, opos kai ton stafylion. Euge! /
parts.body: Wheat is growing very well this year, so are grapes as well. Brilliant, no?
parts.translation: Пшеница растёт очень хорошо в этом году, как и виноград. Блестяще, не так ли?

parts.prefix: v2;30;Pragamati, etsi faínetai: Éxoume to períergo kairo edo na efcharistísoume. /
parts.body: Yes, it seems so: We have the weird weather here to thank.
parts.translation: Да, кажется, так: У нас странная погода для благодарности.

parts.prefix: v1;60;Akoma kai an den bgazei noima! /
parts.body: Even if it doesn't make any sense to me!
parts.translation: Даже, если она не имеет никакого смысла для меня!

parts.prefix: v1;0;Thymáste tin kataigída tis proales? Milao gia ekeinon ton kolokairo! /
parts.body: Do you remember the thunderstorm we had? I mean the really heavy one!
parts.translation: Ты помнишь, какая у нас была гроза? Я имею в виду одну очень сильную!

parts.prefix: v2;30;Fysiká. Sxedon katastráfike olokliri i synkomidí mas. O Theos na mas prostateuei. /
parts.body: Of course. Almost ruined our harvest. Nature is quite impressive, eh?
parts.translation: Конечно. Она почти разрушила наш урожай. Природа впечатляет, да?

parts.prefix: v1;60;Megalo to onoma tou! Paraligo na me xtipisei o satanas me kerauno! /
parts.body: Impressive is one thing. But I was almost hit by a lightning bolt!
parts.translation: Впечатляет одно дело. Но в меня чуть не попала молния!

parts.prefix: v2;100;Katse ore sto spiti sou xristiane! Afou ekso itan epikyndina! /
parts.body: You were not in your house? You know it's dangerous outside during a storm!
parts.translation: Ты был не дома? Ты же знаешь, что это опасно быть снаружи во время шторма!

parts.body: Live and learn.
I am not feeling well...
parts.job: ru|I am not feeling well...

parts.body: What's wrong with you? Are you sick?
parts.job: ru|What's wrong with you? Are you sick?

parts.body: Nope, I j-j-just remembered someth-thing.
parts.job: ru|Nope, I j-j-just remembered someth-thing.

parts.prefix: v2;100;Den akougetai kala. Eísai sígouros oti den eísai árrostos? /
parts.body: You sound really bad. Are you sure you are not sick?
parts.job: ru|You sound really bad. Are you sure you are not sick?

parts.body: N-no, I just f-feel scared.
parts.job: ru|N-no, I just f-feel scared.

parts.body: So what happened?
parts.job: ru|So what happened?

parts.job: ru|During the l-last thunderstorm. I walked outside the v-v-village, I knew I could not get back to the village before the storm. So I hid under a tree.

parts.body: You risked your life outside the village! You could have died!
parts.job: ru|You risked your life outside the village! You could have died!

parts.prefix: v1;240;Loipon, ímoun asfalís. Sti synécheia,pou les, eída éna gouroúni. Mpam! To xtypise keraunos . Kai ... a-afto sikothike kai kiníthike l-san ki emás, Kai me kinygise me mia spatha! /

parts.job: ru|Well, I was safe. But then I saw a pig. The lighning struck it. And the dead p-pig... I-it got up and moved l-like us, ch-chasing me with a shiny sw-sword!

parts.body: It was true! True! True! True!
parts.job: ru|It was true! True! True! True!

parts.prefix: v1;60;Típota to idiaítero gia éna apomakrysméno xorio san to diko mas! /
parts.body: Nothing special for a remote village like ours!
parts.job: ru|Nothing special for a remote village like ours!

parts.prefix: v1;0;Otan ímoun mikros, íthela na eínai énas exerevnitís, na anakalýpsoun néa edáfi kai na pliroún endiaférontes néous anthropous. Allá tora? Eímai kollísei se afto to apomakrysméno chorioudáki. Thélo na páo kai na episkeftheíte néa méri. /
parts.body: When I was young, I wanted to be an explorer, discover new lands and meet interesting new people. But now? I am stuck in this remote little village. I want to go and visit new places.
parts.translation: Когда я был молодым  я хотел стать исследователем, чтобы открывать новые земли и встречать новых интересных людей. Но сейчас? Я застрял в этой глухой деревеньке. Я хочу идти и посещать новые места.

parts.prefix: v2;30;Allá den tha vreíte megáli diaforá sto állo chorio. Eímaste oloi lígo polý to ídio. /
parts.body: But you won't find much difference in the other village. We're all pretty much the same.
parts.translation: Но ты не найдёшь разницы в другой деревне. Мы все очень сильно похожи.

parts.prefix: v1;60;Den milo gia ta choriá. Milo gia tis poleis, í akoma kai i Poli! /
parts.body: I am not speaking about villages. I am speaking about towns, or even the city!
parts.translation: Я говорю не о деревнях. Я говорю о городах, или даже о большом городе!

parts.body: THE city? You mean Constantinople?
parts.translation: Большой город? Ты имеешь ввиду Константинополь?

parts.prefix: v1;120;Nai! To kéntro tis éndoxis aftokratorías mas. Eínai to thávma tou kosmou. /
parts.body: Yeah! The centre of our glorious empire. It is the wonder of the world.
parts.translation: Да! Центр нашей славной империи. Это чудо света.

parts.prefix: v1;150;Ypárchoun perissoteroi apo 500 000 ánthropoi pou zoun ekeí, boreíte na imangine afto?! /
parts.body: There are more than 500 000 people living there, can you imangine that?!
parts.translation: Там живёт более 500 000 людей, ты можешь себе это представить?!

parts.prefix: v2;180;Akoúgetai adýnato gia ména. 500 000 ánthropoi se éna méros? /
parts.body: Sounds impossible to me. 500 000 people in one place? Dream on!
parts.translation: Звучит невозможно для меня. 500 000 людей в одном месте? Мечтай дальше!

parts.body: Don't drink wine alone!

parts.prefix: v2;30;To na pineis mazí eínai pio diaskedastiko! /
