parts.translation: Не раздражай меня с этой кучкой чудаков. Наши здания выглядят намного лучше!

parts.body: Well...

parts.prefix: v1;100;Prodoti! Den echeis kamía ethnikí yperifáneia? /
parts.body: Traitor! Have you got no national pride?
parts.translation: Предатель! У тебя нет национальной гордости?

parts.prefix: v1;0;Emeís oi Romaíoi eimaste poli yperífanoi gia ta osa échoume petýchei! /
parts.body: We Romans can be really proud of what we have achieved!
parts.translation: Мы Римляне должны быть горды тем, чего мы добились!

parts.prefix: v2;30;Fysiká! o,ti blepeis égine apo emás! /
parts.body: Of course! Everything you see was made by us!
parts.translation: Конечно! Всё что ты видишь сделано нами!

parts.prefix: v1;60;I pio ischyrí Autokratoría stin istoría! /
parts.body: The most powerful empire in the world's history!
parts.translation: Самая мощная империя в мировой истории!

parts.prefix: v2;90;Álla éthni tha apoláfsoun tin doxa mas. /
parts.body: Other nations shall bask in our glory.
parts.translation: Другие народы будут греться в нашей славе.

parts.body: They have to! We are the rulers!

parts.prefix: v1;0;I Romaïkí autokratoría tha kyvernísei ton kosmo gia álli mia forá! /
parts.body: The Roman empire will rule the world once again!
parts.translation: Римская империя будет править миром еще раз!

parts.body: We will!
Everything will be better then!
Yeah!
Cheers for the empire!
Cheers!
It will rain. Soon.
I can feel it, too.

parts.prefix: v1;60;Períergo. Eínai pánta o idios arithoms imeron méchri na vréxei. /
parts.body: Weird. It is always the same amount of days until it rains.
parts.translation: Странно. Всегда проходит одно и тоже количество дней до дождя.

parts.body: Do you think so, too?

parts.prefix: v2;125;Períergos kairos edo, étsi den eínai? /
parts.body: Weird life here, isn't it?
parts.translation: Странная жизнь здесь, не так ли?

parts.body: For sure!

parts.prefix: v1;0;Koíta afto to gouroúni! Eínai charitoméno, étsi den eínai? /
parts.body: Look at this pig! It is cute, isn't it?
parts.translation: Посмотри на эту свинку! Это мило, не правда ли?

parts.body: WAAAaaah, go away!
Are you scared of pigs?
N-no! I am not!
Hahahahahaha! Now this is funny!

parts.prefix: v2;0;Aaa ... Kalo souvláki. Thélete mia boukiá? /
parts.body: Ahh... Good souvlaki. Want a bite?
*Bites*
Thank you! I love souvlaki.
Who does not!

parts.prefix: v1;100;Échete poté prospathísei na paspalisete me xoma to souvláki? /
parts.body: Have you ever tried to put some dirt on Souvlaki?
parts.translation: Ты когда-нибудь пробывал добавить немного земли в сувлаки?

parts.body: No?

parts.prefix: v1;170;Merikés forés to káno ... Ach .. ola xekínisan otan souvláki mou épese sto édafos pérysi ... Exaireto! /
parts.body: Sometimes I do... Ah.. It all started when my souvlaki fell on the ground last year... Delicous!
parts.translation: Иногда... Эх... Все началось, когда мой саувлаки упал на землю в прошлом году ... Очень вкусно!

parts.prefix: v2;220;Periménete! Epese to souvláki sou stin vromiá kai to efages? Ti sto diáolo ..? /
parts.body: Wait! You put your souvlaki into the dirt and then eat it? What the hell..?
parts.translation: Стой! Ты уронил саувлаки на землю, а затем съел? Что за чёрт..?

parts.body: But it tastes good!
You are really mad.
I want to ride a pig!
Why?
It's fun!

parts.prefix: v2;80;Giatí sto kalo na odigíseis éna gouroúni? /
parts.body: Why the heck would you ride a pig?
parts.translation: Какого чёрта вы ездиете на свинье?

parts.body: Because it is fun!
You're mad.

parts.prefix: v1;0;Échete akoúsei gia to mystiko tou xylokopou? /
parts.body: Have you already heard of the lumberman's secret?
parts.translation: Вы уже слышали о секрете лесоруба?

parts.body: No, whats wrong with him?
parts.translation: Нет, что с ним не так?

parts.prefix: v1;60;Faínetai na syllégoun ta míla, kai ta poloún stous Normandoús! /
parts.body: He seems to collect apples, and sell them to those Normans!
parts.translation: Он кажется собирает яблоки и продаёт их норманнам!

parts.prefix: v2;90;No way! Kai kratán ta chrímata? /
parts.body: No way! And he keeps the money?
parts.translation: Ни в коем случае! И он получает деньги?

parts.body: Of course!

parts.prefix: v1;0;O sýzygos mou eípe oti énas Eparxos tha episkeftheí to chorio mas sýntoma! /
parts.body: My husband said that a baron will visit our village soon!
parts.translation: Мой муж сказал, что нашу деревню скоро посетит барон!

parts.body: Why should he come here?

parts.prefix: v2;40;Éna tétoios ischyros, arenopos kai omorfos ántras ... /
parts.body: Such a mighty, strong and handsome man...
parts.translation: Такой могучий, сильный и красивый мужчина ...

parts.body: What? You like them?

parts.prefix: v2;100;Prépei na paradechto pos... eínai elkystikos! /
parts.body: You have to admit that they are attractive!
parts.translation: Вы должны признать, что он привлекателен!

parts.prefix: v1;0;Ypárchei mia poutana sto geitoniko chorio! /
parts.body: There is a loose woman in the neighboring village!
parts.translation: В соседней деревне есть свободная женщина!

parts.prefix: v1;20;Sýmfona me tous ischyrismoús, akomi kai oi ándres tou chorioú mas échoun páei ekeí! /
parts.body: Allegedly, even men of our village have gone there!
parts.translation: Якобы, даже мужчины из нашей деревни пошли туда!

parts.prefix: v2;60;Kaka mantata! Écho na amfisvitísei ton ántra mou! /
parts.body: Terrible news! I have to question my husband!
parts.translation: Ужасная новость! У спрошу моего мужа!

parts.prefix: v1;90;O dikos faínetai na eínai athoos. Den eímai sígourii gia to diko sas, agapiti mou! /
parts.body: Mine seems to be innocent. Not sure about yours, my dear!
parts.translation: Мой кажется невинным. Не уверена насчёт твоего, моя дорогая!

parts.body: I hope he is as well. He'd better be.
parts.translation: Я надеюсь, что он тоже. Он может лучшее.

parts.prefix: v1;0;Mou arései na vlépo paidiá na paízoun! /
parts.body: I love to see children playing!
parts.translation: Я люблю смотреть как играют дети!

parts.prefix: v1;20;Tha me kánei pánta na thélo na écho éna kai ego! /
parts.body: It always makes me want to have a baby!
parts.translation: Это всегда заставляет меня хотеть ребёнка!

parts.prefix: v2;50;Eíste sígouroi oti eíste se thési na to antéxete oikonomiká? /
parts.body: Are you sure that you are able to afford it?
parts.translation: Вы уверены, что ты в состоянии себе это позволить?

parts.body: Children are expensive!

parts.prefix: v1;100;Den me anisycheí auto! O antras mou échei arketá chrímata. /
parts.body: No worries here! My man has more than enough money.
parts.translation: Не беспокойтесь об этом! Мой мужчина имеет более чем достаточно денег.

parts.prefix: v1;0;Agapiti mou, o ánthropos sas eínai énas méthysos! /
parts.body: My dear, your man is a drunkard!

parts.prefix: v2;15;Pos mporeís na to les afto? /
parts.body: How can you say that?

parts.prefix: v1;45;O sýzygos sas írthe methysménos sto spíti mas chthes to vrády! /
parts.body: Your husband came drunk to our house last night!
parts.translation: Твой муж пришел пьяный в наш дом вчера вечером!

parts.prefix: v1;70;Eípe oti thélei na pantrefteí éna provato. /
parts.body: He said that he wants to marry a sheep.
parts.translation: Он сказал, что хочет жениться на овце.

parts.prefix: v1;100;Kai oti tha ypárxei mia terástia gamilia teleti! /
parts.body: And that there would be a huge wedding celebration!
parts.translation: И что будет огромное празднование свадьбы!

parts.prefix: v1;130;Se Parakalo, balte ton se mia seira! /
parts.body: Please, regain control over your man.
parts.translation: Пожалуйста, восстанови контроль над своим мужчиной.

parts.body: It is really creepy.
Alright alright, I will punish him!
No wine for him!

parts.prefix: v1;0;To psomí sas eínai toso nostimo! Poio eínai to mystiko sas? /
parts.body: Your bread is so delicious! What is your secret?
parts.translation: Твой хлеб такой вкусный! В чем твой секрет?

parts.body: Just add little bit of sugar inside.
Really? Nothing more?
That's it! You will taste the difference.
parts.translation: Вот и все! Вы почувствуете разницу.

parts.prefix: v1;0;Poios ítan o ántras pou σε episkeftheíke echthes to brády? /
parts.body: Who was the man who visited you last night?
parts.translation: Кто был тот мужчина, который был у тебя прошлой ночью?

parts.body: What man?

parts.prefix: v1;40;O ánthropos pou sýrthike éxo apo to paráthyro sou! /
parts.body: The man who crawled out of your window!

parts.prefix: v1;45;Min nomízeis oti den tha to paratirousa! /
parts.body: Don't think I wouldn't notice!
parts.translation: Не думаю, что я бы не заметила!

parts.prefix: v2;60;Pos tolmás ..? Ímoun kai tha eímai pánta pistí sto sýzygo mou! /
parts.body: How dare you..? I was and am always faithful to my husband.
parts.translation: Как ты смеешь..? Я была всегда верна своему мужу.

parts.body: Yeah, yeah. I would say that as well if I were you.
parts.translation: Да да. Я хочу сказать это так, даже если я это ты.

parts.prefix: v2;110;Afto den eínai díkaio! Min diadídeis fímes gia eména! /
parts.body: That's not fair! Don't spread rumors about me.
parts.translation: Это не справедливо! Не распространяй слухи про меня.

parts.prefix: v1;0;Aftá ta néa ergaleía mageirikís eínai exairetika! /
parts.body: These new cooking tools are extraordinary!
parts.translation: Эти новые инструменты приготовления пищи необычны!

parts.prefix: v2;30;Nai, kánei to mageírema toso éfkolo! Eínai diaskedastiko! /
parts.body: Yes, it makes cooking so easy! It is fun!
parts.translation: Да, это делает приготовление пищи проще! Это весело!

parts.prefix: v1;60;Efcharisto pigaínei stous Smiths kai technítes, oi opoíoi skefteí tétoia prágmata! /
parts.body: Thank goes to the smiths and artisans, who thought of such things!
parts.translation: Спасибо кузнецам и ремесленникам, что придумали такие вещи!

parts.prefix: v2;90;Nai! Gi 'afto mou arései na Romaïkí. /
parts.body: Yes! That's why I love to be Roman.
parts.translation: Да! Вот почему я люблю быть римлянкой.

parts.body: I am envious of those rich people.

parts.prefix: v1;20;Échoun tétoia oraía roúcha apo metáxi! /
parts.body: They have such nice silk clothes!
parts.translation: У них такая красивая шелковая одежда!

parts.prefix: v2;50;Afto den eínai pragmatiká díkaios. Den kánoun típota kai na párete ta kalýtera prágmata pou oútos í állos. /
parts.body: That's really not fair. They do nothing and get the best things anyway.
parts.translation: Это и вправду несправедливо. Они ничего не делают и все равно получают самое лучшее.

parts.prefix: v1;0;Échete akoúsei gia afto to Eparxo se éna geitoniko chorio? /
parts.body: Have you heard of this baron in a neighboring village?
parts.translation: Слышали ли вы, что барон в соседней деревне?

parts.prefix: v2;30;Nai, afto eínai to éna tou opoíou i gynaíka vréthike dolofoniméni? /
parts.body: Yes, it is the one whose wife was found murdered?
parts.translation: Да, это тот, чья жена была найдена убитой?

parts.prefix: v1;60;Akrivos! O sýzygos mou mou eípe oti o Eparxos dolofonise ti gynaíka tou! /
parts.body: Exactly! My husband just told me that the baron himself killed his own wife!
parts.translation: Точно! Мой муж только что сказал мне, что барон сам убил свою жену!

parts.body: What..?

parts.prefix: v2;130;Pánta íxera oti gialize to mati tou! /
parts.body: I always knew that he was going to!
parts.translation: Я всегда знала, что он собирается сделать это!

parts.body: But nobody believed me..!

parts.prefix: v1;0;Échete poté skefteí gia to pos tha ítan an eíchame ton polemo? /
parts.body: Have you ever thought of how it would be if we had war?
parts.translation: Задумывалась ли ты о том, что было бы, если бы у нас была война?

parts.prefix: v1;30;Ypárchoun akomi kai tora oi ándres pou agonízontai gia ti chora mas! /
parts.body: There even now men fighting for our country!
parts.translation: Даже сейчас люди борются за нашу страну!

parts.body: I really admire them!
A war would be terrible.
I guess you just like soldiers.
parts.translation: Я думаю ты такая же, как солдаты.

parts.body: But you have a husband!
But a lazy and often drunk one!
parts.translation: Но он ленивый и часто пьёт!

rows.raw: //v1;0;Xérete tin despinida sto geitoniko chorio? / Do you know the beauty in the neighbouring village?
//v2;30;Fysiká, eínai polý charitoméni. / Of course, she is really cute.
//v1;60;Ti tha gínei me tin epískepsi tis? / What about visiting her?
//v2;90;Xérete oti i gynaíka sas tha trelathei tote! / You know that your wife will go crazy then!
//v1;0;Sýzygos tou techníti eínai polý omorfi, den nomízeis? / The artisan's wife is very good-looking, what do you think?
//v2;40;Nai, den eínai kakia. Dystychos aftí eínai ídi pantreméni! / Yeah, she is not bad. Sadly,she already is married!
//v1;70;Ontos... Kai den tha ítan díkao gia afton. / Well, yeah. And it wouldn't be fair to him.

parts.prefix: v1;0;Den échoume arketo krasí se afto to chorio! /
parts.body: We do not have enough wine in this village!
parts.translation: У нас недостаточно вина в этой деревне!

parts.prefix: v2;30;Symfono! Prépei na chtísoume perissotera ampélia! /
parts.body: I agree! We need to build more vineries!
parts.translation: Соглашусь! Нам нужно построить больше виноградников!

parts.body: And more taverns!
What about opening our own tavern?
parts.translation: Как насчёт открыть нашу собственную таверну?

parts.body: Great idea! Let's plan this.
But where do we start?

parts.prefix: v1;180;Kai oi gynaíkes mas den tha eínai eftychís otan to akousoun! /
parts.body: And our wives won't be happy to hear that!
parts.translation: И наши жены не будут рады услышать это!

parts.prefix: v2;210;Ochi,i polisi romaïkou krasíou eínai pánta mia kali dikaiología! /
parts.body: Nope, selling Roman wine is always an excuse!
parts.translation: Нет, продажа римского вина всегда оправдание!

parts.prefix: v1;240;Entáxei! Sti synécheia, afíste mas na exoikonomísete chrímata mas. /
parts.body: Alright! Then let us save our money.
parts.translation: Хорошо! Тогда давайте экономить наши деньги.

parts.prefix: v1;270;Otan échoume kerdísei arketá, as ekplirosoume to schédio mas! /
parts.body: When we've earned enough, let us fulfill our plan!
parts.translation: Когда мы заработаем достаточно, давайте выполним наш план!

parts.prefix: v2;300;Tha échoume ti megalýteri tavérna se oli tin autokratoría! /
parts.body: We will have the greatest tavern in the whole empire!
parts.translation: У нас будет самая большая таверна во всей империи!

parts.body: For sure!

rows.raw: //v1;0;Échete dokimásei poté Normandika ergaleía? / Have you ever tried Norman tools?

//v2;30;Ochi, allá écho akoúsei oti eínai polý apotelesmatika! / Nope, but I have heard that they are very effective!//v1;60;Eínai alítheia. Poté den eícha doulépsei me tétoia kalá ergaleía prin. / It is true. I had never worked with such good tools before.
//v2;90;Periménete ... Échete éna Normandiko ergalio? / Wait... You have a Norman tool?
//v1;120;Err, eícha. Échei chatheí! / Err, I had. It has somehow gone missing!
//v2;140;TI? Eíches éna tétoio ergaleío kai to echáses? / WHAT? You had such a tool and you lost it?
//v1;170;Nai ... Tora ypárchoun mono anamníseis... / Yeah... Now there are only memories left...
//v1;0;Xexe! Ímoun molis dokimasa to neo ropalo! / Boom! I was just able to check out the new mace!
//v2;30;Nai! Prokeitai gia éna fovero oplo! Eínai chtypá tous echthroús makriá! / Yes! It is an awesome weapon! It knocks enemies far away!
//v1;60;Entyposiako, e? Afto to Romaïko aristoúrgima den boreí na synkritheí me otidípote állo xeno oplo. / Impressive, eh? This Roman masterpiece cannot be compared to anything else in this world.
//v2;100;Gia auto mporoúme na eímaste yperífanoi pou eimaste Romaíoi! / That's why we can be proud to be Romans!

parts.prefix: v1;0;Yperoxo fagito, panysxira opla, exaisia téchni - afto eínai to éthnos mas! /
parts.body: Great food, great weapons, great art - that's what our nation is about!
parts.translation: Отличная еда, великолепное оружие, великое искусство - вот каков наш народ!

parts.body: And great wine!

parts.prefix: v1;0;Echo varetheí ti sýzygo mou. Thélo na écho mia kainoúrgia! /
parts.body: I am bored of my wife. I want to have a new one!
parts.translation: Я устал от моей жены. Я хочу новую!

parts.body: Who doesn't?

parts.prefix: v1;60;Ísos prépei na afísoume xafniká to chorio kai sti synécheia na psáxoume gia néa! /
parts.body: Maybe we should suddenly leave the village and then search for new ones!
parts.translation: Может быть нам внезапно покинуть деревню и поискать новых!

parts.prefix: v2;90;Nai! Oi Máya kai oi Indoí échoun tétoies omorfes gynaíkes, échete dei? /
parts.body: Yes! The Mayans and the Indians have such beautiful wives, have you seen?
parts.translation: Да! У Майя и индейцев такие красивые жёны, ты видел?

parts.prefix: v2;140;Allá ... To chorio chánetai chorís emás. /
parts.body: But... This village is lost without us.
parts.translation: Но... Эта деревня потеряется без нас.

parts.prefix: v2;160;Kai min xechnáte ta paidiá mas! /
parts.body: And don't forget our children!
parts.translation: И не забывай про наших детей!

parts.prefix: v1;180;Urgh! Ta paidiá mas! Den tha epiviosoun chorís patéra! /
parts.body: Urgh! Our children! They won't survive without a father!
parts.translation: Ах! Наши дети! Они не выживут без отца!

parts.prefix: v1;220;Allá ... afto simaínei oti prépei na synechísoume tin varetí zoí mas edo? /
parts.body: But... does this mean that we have to go on with our boring life here?
parts.translation: Но... значит ли это то, что мы должны продолжать нашу скучную жизнь?

parts.prefix: v2;255;Ypothéto oti aftos eínai o kalýteros tropos. /
parts.body: I guess this is the best way to go.
parts.translation: Я думаю, что это лучший путь.

parts.prefix: v1;0;Eínai apístefto poso leptomerí einai eikones sas. /
parts.body: It is quite incredible how detailed your icons look.
parts.translation: Это невероятно насколько подробно изображены твои иконы.

parts.prefix: v2;30;Fysiká, eínai i lampri romaïkí téchni! /
parts.body: Of course, as it is great Roman art!

parts.prefix: v1;60;Opos kai o, ti kánoume. Koitáxte ta omorfa spítia mas! /
parts.body: Like everything we do. Look at our beautiful houses!
parts.translation: Как и все, что мы делаем. Посмотри на наши красивые дома!

parts.prefix: v2;90;Kai min xechnáte tin éndoxi istoría mas! /
parts.body: And don't forget our glorious history!
parts.translation: И не забывай про нашу славную историю!

parts.prefix: v1;0;Thymáste to korítsi pou polémousame stin paidikí mas ilikía mas? /
parts.body: You remember the girl we fought over in our childhood?
parts.translation: Ты помнишь девушку, за которую мы боролись в нашем детстве?

parts.prefix: v2;30; Nai ... kaloi kairoi. Pali kala pou teliosan. /
parts.body: Yeah... It was a very bad time. Good that it's over.
parts.translation: Да уж... Это было очень плохое время. Хорошо, что все закончилось.

parts.prefix: v1;60;Chaíromai pou to akoúo, giatí mou eípe oti tis aresa apo pánta! /
parts.body: Glad to hear that, because she just told me that she always liked me!
parts.translation: Рад это слышать, потому что она только что сказала мне, что она всегда любила меня!

parts.body: What? That's not true!

parts.prefix: v1;0;Geia sou omorfiá, sas arései afto pou vlépete? /
parts.body: Hey beauty, do you like what you see?
parts.translation: Эй красотка, тебе нравится, что ты видишь?

parts.body: *slap*
You have a wife.

parts.prefix: v1;0;Geia sou, koitás polý oraía símera $targetfirstname! /
parts.body: Hey, you look very nice today $targetfirstname!
Thank you!
As always, my dear!

parts.prefix: v1;0;Hey $targetfirstname mia omorfiá opos eseís prepei na echei enan omorfo ántras san ki eména! /
parts.body: Hey $targetfirstname, does a beauty like you are want a handsome guy like me?
parts.translation: Эй $targetfirstname, такая красотка как ты не хочет ли такого парня как я?

parts.body: You are married, and I am as well.
parts.translation: Вы состоите в браке и я тоже.

parts.prefix: v2;60;Ypothéto oti den eíste pistoí! Tha po sti gynaíka sas! /
parts.body: I guess you aren't faithful! I will tell your wife!
parts.translation: Я думаю, вы не верны! Я расскажу вашей жене!

parts.body: NO - Don't do tha-
I am his evil twin brother!

parts.prefix: v2;120;Fysiká eíste! To ídio kako gioftopouli pou katouraei ston mpaxtse mou kathe sabbato! /
parts.body: Of course you are! The same evil twin who is always drunk!
parts.translation: Конечно вы! Тот же злобный брат-близнец, который всегда пьян!

parts.prefix: v1;0;Pos pane ta pragmata me tin gynaíka sas? /
parts.body: How is it going with your woman-stuff?
Good good, except for feeling a little bit bad...
parts.translation: Хорошо хорошо, за исключением плохого самочувствия...

parts.body: Oh no, what happened?
My husband shouted at me.

parts.prefix: v1;120;Pos boreí o ídios se mia tétoia omorfiá? /
parts.body: How can he to such a beauty?
parts.translation: Как он может поступать так с такой красотой?

parts.body: Thank you for cheering me up, $targetfirstname!
*urgh*
Are you alright, $targetfirstname?

parts.prefix: v2;50;Nai, afto eínai mono i sklirí douleiá! /
parts.body: Yes, it is just the hard work!

parts.prefix: v1;70;Boro na sas voithíso? Tha aisthantheíte kalýtera sti synécheia? /
parts.body: May I help you? Would you feel better then?
parts.translation: Могу ли я помочь? Может тогда вы будете чувствовать себя лучше?

parts.body: Of course! Thank you!
How is it going?
Everything is fine, what about you?

parts.prefix: v1;60;Pára polý! Efcharisto gia tin erotisi. /
parts.body: It is, too! Thanks for asking.
parts.translation: У меня тоже! Спасибо за вопрос.

parts.prefix: v1;75;Allá vlépo oti ypárchei káti pou se enochleí! /
parts.body: But I see there is something that bothers you!
parts.translation: Но я вижу, что тебя что-то беспокоит!

parts.body: It is - nothing.
Please tell me!

parts.prefix: v2;130;Eínai mono oti i zoí mou edo eínai toso varetí. /
parts.body: It is only that my life here is so dull.
parts.translation: Только то, что моя жизнь такая скучная.

parts.prefix: v2;160;Efchomai pragmatiká na eícha apofasísei na páei se mia poli otan ímoun néos! /
parts.body: I really wish I had decided to go to a city when I was young!
parts.translation: Мне очень жаль я решил пойти в город, когда я был молод!

parts.prefix: v1;0;Adelfe $targetfirstname, eínai kalo na sas doúme! /
parts.body: Brother $targetfirstname, it is good to see you!

parts.prefix: v1;30;Vríka ton palio xýlino spathí mas! /
parts.body: I just found our old wooden sword!
parts.translation: Я только что нашёл наш старый деревянный меч!

parts.body: Do you remember?

parts.prefix: v2;80;Periménete! Eínai afto to xífos tou patéra mas,auto pou mas édose? /
parts.body: Wait! Is it this sword our father gave us?
parts.translation: Подожди! Разве это тот меч, что наш отец дал ​​нам?

parts.prefix: v1;110;Eínai! Thymáste tous agones mas me afto? /
parts.body: It is! Do you remember our fights with it?
parts.translation: Так и есть! Ты помнишь наши бои с ним?

parts.prefix: v2;140;Pos tha boroúsa na tous xecháso! Exakoloutho na écho kápoia simádia. /
parts.body: How could I forget! I still have some scars.
parts.translation: Как я могу забыть! У меня до сих пор остались шрамы.

parts.body: While thinking more about it...
parts.translation: В то время как думаю больше об этом...

parts.prefix: v2;200;Ítan skliro pou o patéras mas mas edose mono ena! /
parts.body: It was kind of cruel of our father to give us just one sword!
parts.translation: Это была какая-то жестокость нашего отца, что он дал нам только один меч!

parts.prefix: v2;240;Íxere oti tha agonistoúme gia afto! /
parts.body: He knew that we would fight for it!
parts.translation: Он знал, что мы будем бороться за него!

parts.body: I guess it is alright!
Because you kept it!

parts.prefix: v1;0;Thymáste ton iníocho pou agápise toso polý stin paidikí ilikía mas? /
parts.body: Do you remember the charioteer we loved so much in our childhood?
parts.translation: Ты помнишь возничего, которые мы так любили в детстве?

parts.prefix: v2;30;Thymamai adelfi. Ímastan oi megalýteroi opadoí tou! /
parts.body: Of course sister. We were the biggest fans!
parts.translation: Конечно, сестрёнка. Мы были самыми большими его поклонниками!

parts.body: I wonder what happend to him.
You hear nothing of him anymore...
parts.translation: Ты ничего не слышал о нём больше...

parts.prefix: v2;120;Eínai pithanon na enkatastáthike s 'éna chorio san to diko mas kai tora na echei mia sýzygo kai paidiá. /
parts.body: He likely settled down in a village like ours and had a wife and children.
parts.translation: Он, вероятно, поселился в деревне, как наша и у него есть жена и дети.

parts.prefix: v1;150;Télos pánton exakoloutho na elpízo oti tha ton synantíso kápoia stigmí! /
parts.body: Anyway I still hope to meet him some time!
parts.translation: Во всяком случае я все еще надеюсь встретиться с ним как-нибудь!

parts.body: Me too!

parts.prefix: v1;0;$targetfirstname, adelfí mou, pánta anarotiomoun giatí pantréftike afto to ypokeimeno. /
parts.body: $targetfirstname, my sister, I always wanted to know why you married this jerk.
parts.translation: $targetfirstname, моя сестра, я всегда хотел знать, почему ты вышла замуж за этого идиота.

parts.body: Because I love him!

parts.prefix: v1;60;Kai tora to onomá sas eínai $targetlastname. $targetlastname! Akoúgetai toso aschymo! /
parts.body: And now your name is $targetlastname. $targetlastname! It sounds so bad!
parts.translation: Теперь твоё имя $targetlastname. $targetlastname! Это звучит так плохо!

parts.prefix: v2;90;Hey! Min ginesai kakia! Eseís eisastan pou xekínisate tin sýnkrousi. /
parts.body: Hey! Don't be so mean! It was you who started the conflict.
parts.translation: Эй! Не будь таким! Ты был тем, кто начал конфликт.

parts.body: You were drunk!

parts.prefix: v1;0;Échete akoúsei gia tous Tourkalades apó ti stigmí pou ftásame edó? /
parts.body: Have you heard about the Seljuks since we arrived here?
parts.job: ru|Have you heard about the Seljuks since we arrived here?

parts.body: No, I have not, did you think they came with us to this land?
parts.translation: Нет, не слышал. Думаешь, они прибыли с нами на эту новую землю?

parts.prefix: v1;60;Amfivállo, échoume ídi akoúsei apó anthrópous pou den gnorízame óti ypírchan. /
parts.body: I doubt it, we have already heard from people that we didn't know existed.
parts.translation: Сомневаюсь, мы уже слышали о людях, о существовании которых даже не догадывались.

parts.prefix: v2;90;Ypothéto óti prépei na kánoume néous echthroús se aftí ti gi. /
parts.body: I guess we have to make new enemies in this land.
parts.translation: Похоже, нам надо будет найти новых врагов на этих землях.

parts.prefix: v1;120;Échoume akóma tous Normandoús na antimetopísoume. /
parts.body: We still have the Normans to deal with.
parts.translation: Нам все еще надо расправиться с норманами.

parts.prefix: v2;150;Loipón, eímaste Romaíoi! Boroúme éfkola na nikísoume tétoious epidromeís, sti Rómi! /
parts.body: Well, we are Romans! We can easily defeat such raiders, To Rome!
parts.translation: Мы же Римляне! Мы с легкостью победим таких легких захватчиков! За Рим!

parts.body: To Rome!

rows.raw: //v1;0;Ach, poios den thélei frésko, nóstimo psomí apó to agróktima sitarioú? / Ah, who doesn't want fresh, yummy bread from the wheat farm?
//v2;30;Xérete óti chreiazómaste éna artopoieío gia na metatrépsoume to sitári se psomí sostá? / You do know that we need a bakery in order to turn the wheat into bread right?
//v1;60;Prépei na me gelás. Tóra tha petháno. / You've got to be kidding me. Now I'm going to starve.
//v2;90;Limoktoneis? Símera to proí efáges to proinó mou! Tha eímai o peinasménos. / Starve? This morning you ate my breakfast! I will be the one starving.
//v1;120;To chreiázomoun perissótero apó oti eséna! / I need it more than you!
//v2;150;Den xéro giatí sou miláo! / I don't know why I talk to you!
//v1;180;Chreiazómaste éna artopoieío, aftó eínai simantikó. / We need a bakery, that's what matters.

parts.prefix: v1;0;Akoúsate gia to kontinó Normandiko chorió? /
parts.body: Did you hear about the Norman village nearby?
parts.translation: Ты слышал о Норманской деревушке неподалеку?

parts.prefix: v2;30;Aftó den eínai kaló, thymámai óti synéchizan na epitíthentai sti nótia Italía protoú ftásoume edó. /
parts.body: That's not good, I remember that they kept attacking Southern Italy before we came here.
parts.translation: Помню, как они нападали на Южную Италию, до того, как мы прибыли в эти земли.

parts.prefix: v1;60;As elpísoume óti den tha mas epitethoún. /
parts.body: Let's hope they won't raid us.
parts.translation: Надеюсь, они не нападут на нас.

parts.body: I hope that too.
I wonder what happened to Constantinople?

parts.prefix: v2;30;Nomízo óti írthe edó mazí mas se aftí ti néa gi. /
parts.body: I think it came here with us to this new land.
parts.translation: Я думаю, что он попал на эти земли с нами.

parts.body: Why do you think that?

parts.prefix: v2;90;Ézisa kontá sti megáli póli kai me odígisan edó. /
parts.body: I lived near the great city and I was taken here.
parts.translation: Я жил рядом с большим городом и потом попал сюда.

parts.prefix: v1;120;Eínai alítheia, allá échei tósous polloús anthrópous. Tha to eíchame akoúsei méchri tóra. /
parts.body: True, but it has so many people. We would have heard about it by now.
parts.translation: Там же было столько народу. Мы бы давно уже услышали о нем.

parts.prefix: v2;150;Tha boroúse na eínai polý makriá. /
parts.body: It could be very far away.

parts.prefix: v1;180;Nai, allá i dóxa kai i megaloprépeia tis Konstantinoúpolis ítan tóso megáli pou akómi kai ánthropoi stin Kína ákousan gi 'aftin. /
parts.body: Yeah, but Constantinople's glory and splendor is so great that even people in China heard about it.
parts.translation: Да, но слава и великолепие Константинополя настолько велики, что даже люди в Китае слышали об этом.

parts.prefix: v2;210;Mi mou peíte óti pistévete se aftés tis istoríes gia tin Kína? /
parts.body: Don't tell me that you believe in those stories about China?
parts.translation: Только не говори, что ты веришь в эти истории про Китай.

parts.prefix: v1;240;Pistévo óti ypárchei kápoia alítheia se aftá. /
parts.body: I believe that there is some truth to them.
parts.translation: Я считаю, что они отчасти правда.

parts.prefix: v2;270;Allá ypárchoun tósa pollá mystíria gia tin Kína pou den boroúme na ypothésoume an ypárchei kápoia alítheia se aftá. /
parts.body: But there is so much mystery about China we can't assume if there is any truth to them.
parts.translation: Но о Китае так много загадок, что мы не можем предположить, есть ли о них хоть какая-то правда.

parts.prefix: v1;300;Ypárchei tósa pollá mystíria an i Konstantinoúpoli eínai edó, étsi den boroúme na to ypothésoume. /
parts.body: There is so much mystery if Constantinople is here so we can't assume that either.
parts.translation: Слишком много загадок. Мы также не можем предположить, рядом ли Константинополь.

parts.prefix: v2;330;Loipón, nai, allá akóma ki an i Konstantinoúpoli den eínai edó. Prépei na megalósoume kai na prostatépsoume ti Romaïkí Aftokratoría. /
parts.body: Well, yeah, but even if Constantinople isn't here. We need to grow and protect the Roman Empire.
parts.translation: Да, согласен. Но даже если Константинополя больше нет, то нам нужно расти и защищать Римскую Империю.

parts.prefix: v1;360;Tóra boró na symfoníso mazí sas gia aftó! /
parts.body: Now I can agree with you about that!

parts.prefix: v2;390;Ithe i Rómi na diarkesei gia pánta! /
parts.body: May Rome last forever!

rows.raw: //v1;0;Óra na plirósete tous fórous sas. / Time for you to pay your taxes.
//v2;30;Lypámai, allá den ímoun se thési na sygkentróso arketoús pórous. / I'm sorry but I haven't been able to get enough resources.
//v1;60;Thélete na sas ekdióxo apó to chorió? / Do you want me to expel you from the village, imbecile?
//v1;90;Tote frete mou tous forous TORA! / Then come back with your taxes, NOW!

parts.prefix: v1;0;Norítera, miloúsa me énan byzantinó émporo kai mou eípe gia choriá makriná sto chióni. /
parts.body: Earlier, I was talking to a Byzantine trader and he told me about villages far away in the snow.
parts.job: ru|Earlier, I was talking to a Byzantine trader and he told me about villages far away in the snow.

parts.body: Villages in the snow?
parts.job: ru|Villages in the snow?

parts.body: Yeah, they are called "Inuit".
parts.job: ru|Yeah, they are called "Inuit".

parts.prefix: v2;90;Inuites? Ti paráxeno ónoma, pos ítan?/
parts.body: Inuit? What a strange name, what were they like?
parts.job: ru|Inuit? What a strange name, what were they like?

parts.prefix: v1;120;O émporos eípe óti den dexonte chrímata. /
parts.body: The trader said that they don't believe in money.
parts.job: ru|The trader said that they don't believe in money.

parts.prefix: v2;150;Den dexonte chrímata ?! Pós tha boroúsan na zísoun? /
parts.body: Don't believe in money?! How could they live?
parts.job: ru|Don't believe in money?! How could they live?

parts.prefix: v1;180;Óloi moirástikan ta pánta exísou. Itane polý dýskoli i diapragmátefsi mazí tous. /
parts.body: They all just shared everything equally. It made trading with them very difficult.
parts.job: ru|They all just shared everything equally. It made trading with them very difficult.

parts.prefix: v2;210;Katakaimene empore. Touláchiston eínai píso sti Romaïkí Aftokratoría, makriá apó aftoús tous bárbarous. /
parts.body: Poor trader. At least he is back in the Roman Empire, away from those barbarians.
parts.job: ru|Poor trader. At least he is back in the Roman Empire, away from those barbarians.

parts.prefix: v1;240;Symfonó! I Romaïkí Aftokratoría eínai i kalýteri gi gia empório! /
parts.body: I agree! The Roman Empire is the best land to trade!
parts.job: ru|I agree! The Roman Empire is the best land to trade!

//v2;30;Nai, den ypárchei tavérna gia na pioúme. / Yeah, there is no tavern for us to drink at.

Allá tóra ótan skotóno éna várvaro, koitázo to prósopó tou kai skéftomai, "Ísos den prépei na skotónoume aftoús tous anthrópous". / I thought being a soldier would easier, all I expected to do is stand around and kill a few mobs and the occasional barbarian. But now when I kill a barbarian, I look at his face and think, "Maybe we shouldn't be killing these people."

//v2;120;Skéftesai pára polý! Vgeíte éxo kai skotóste várvarous gia ti Rómi. Tha mas skotósoun kai tha katastrépsoun ta spítia mas! Eínai móno asyneíditoi ágrioi. / You think too much! Go out and kill barbarians for Rome. They would kill us and destroy our homes! They are only uncivilized savages.

//v1;150;Synantísate aftoús tous anthrópous pou kirýttete na skotónete? Óchi, den échete, ísos eínai diaforetikoí apó aftó pou mas eípan. / Have you met these people that you are preaching to kill? No, you have not, maybe they are different from what we were told.
//v2;180;Eínai alítheia óti tha boroúsan na eínai polý cheirótera. / True, they could be much worse.
//v1;210;Den nomízo óti katalavaínete tis sképseis kai ta deiná pou pernáo. / I don't think you understand the thoughts and plight I'm going through.

//v2;240;Eímai stratiótis, óchi filósofos. Tha prépei na páte na prosefchitheíte sto Theó gia kathodígisi, kathós safós chreiázeste kápoio. / I'm a soldier, not a philosopher. You should go to pray to God for guidance as you clearly need some.

//v1;270;Écho ídi kai den écho típota perissótero apó ton Theó. Ótan prosefchómoun, émeina me to ídio sympérasma ópos écho tóra. / I already have and I got nothing more from God. When I prayed, I was left with the same conclusion as I have now.

//v2;300;Ti? Échete afísei safós ton Theó gia na min sas po tin alítheia! Pigaínete píso stin prosefchí méchri na borésete na skotósete kai páli tous varvárous! / What? You clearly have forsaken God for Him to not to tell you the truth! Go back to praying until you can kill barbarians again!
//v1;330;Ísos aftó eínai to sympérasma pou o Theós símane gia ména na écho! Tha páo na proséfchomai tóra. / Maybe this is conclusion God meant for me to have!
//v2;360;Akoúgetai perissótero ópos o Theós thélei na syntaxiodotitheíte ... / Sounds more like God wants you to retire...

parts.prefix: v1;0;Elpízo óti den tha chreiasteí na bgoúme éxo kai na polemísoume opoiondípote bárbaro ópote sýntoma. /
parts.body: I hope we don't have to go out and fight any barbarians anytime soon.
parts.translation: Надеюсь, мне не придется снова сражаться с этими варварами.

parts.prefix: v2;30;Ti? Eímaste stratiótes, i douleiá mas eínai na bgoúme éxo kai na skotósoume bárbarous. Giatí tha beíte ston strató an den sas arései na agonízeste? /
parts.body: What? We are soldiers, our job is to go out and kill barbarians. Why would you join the army if you don't like fighting?
parts.translation: Что? Мы же солдаты, это наш долг убивать этих варваров. Почему ты вообще вступил в полк, если не хочешь драться?

parts.prefix: v1;60;Skéftika óti o stratiótis tha ítan efkolóteros, to móno pou perímena na káno eínai na stamatíso kai na skotóso lígous óchlous kai to peristasiakó várvaro. Allá tóra ótan skotóno éna várvaro, koitázo to prósopó tou kai skéftomai, "Ísos den prépei na skotónoume aftoús tous anthrópous". /
parts.body: I thought being a soldier would easier, all I expected to do is stand around and kill a few mobs and the occasional barbarian. But now when I kill a barbarian, I look at his face and think, "Maybe we shouldn't be killing these people."
parts.translation: Я думал, что все будет намного проще, что надо будет лишь убить парочку монстров и какого-нибудь варвара. Но теперь, когда я убиваю варвара, я задумываюсь: "Может, нам не стоит убивать этих людей."

parts.prefix: v2;120;Skéftesai pára polý! Vgeíte éxo kai skotóste várvarous gia ti Rómi. Tha mas skotósoun kai tha katastrépsoun ta spítia mas! Eínai móno asyneíditoi ágrioi. /
parts.body: You think too much! Go out and kill barbarians for Rome. They would kill us and destroy our homes! They are only uncivilized savages.
parts.translation: Много думаешь! Иди и убей варвара за Рим, иначе они убьют нас и разрушат наши дома! Они лишь нецивилизованные дикари.

parts.prefix: v1;150;Synantísate aftoús tous anthrópous pou kirýttete na skotónete? Óchi, den échete, ísos eínai diaforetikoí apó aftó pou mas eípan. /
parts.body: Have you met these people that you are preaching to kill? No, you have not, maybe they are different from what we were told.
parts.translation: А ты хоть раз встречал того человека, которого так хочешь убить? Уверен, что нет. Может, они совсем другие, а не то, что нам рассказывают.

parts.prefix: v2;180;Eínai alítheia óti tha boroúsan na eínai polý cheirótera. /
parts.body: True, they could be much worse.
parts.translation: Согласен, они могут быть даже хуже...

parts.prefix: v1;210;Den nomízo óti katalavaínete tis sképseis kai ta deiná pou pernáo. /
parts.body: I don't think you understand the thoughts and plight I'm going through.
parts.translation: Ты не понимаешь через что я прохожу сейчас.

parts.prefix: v2;240;Eímai stratiótis, óchi filósofos. Tha prépei na páte na prosefchitheíte sto Theó gia kathodígisi, kathós safós chreiázeste kápoio. /
parts.body: I'm a soldier, not a philosopher. You should go to pray to God for guidance as you clearly need some.
parts.translation: Я солдат, а не философ. Сходи и помолись Богу, если тебе так нужен чистый совет.

parts.prefix: v1;270;Den écho típota perissótero apó ton Theó. Ótan prosefchómoun, émeina me to ídio sympérasma ópos écho kai tóra. /
parts.body: I already have and I got nothing more from God. When I prayed, I was left with the same conclusion as I have now.
parts.translation: Уже сходил, но Бог мне так и не ответил. Молитва мне не помогла решить этот вопрос...

parts.prefix: v2;300;Ti? Échete afísei safós ton Theó gia na min sas pei tin alítheia! Pigaínete píso stin prosefchí méchri na borésete na skotósete kai páli tous varvárous! /
parts.body: What? You clearly have forsaken God for Him to not to tell you the truth! Go back to praying until you can kill barbarians again!
parts.translation: Что? Ты отрекся от Бога, поэтому он тебе и не ответил! Иди молиться, пока не решишься убивать варваров!

parts.prefix: v1;330;Ísos aftó eínai to sympérasma pou o Theós símane gia ména na écho! Tha páo na proséfchitho tóra. /
parts.body: Maybe this is conclusion God meant for me to have!
parts.translation: Может, такой исход и предназначал мне Бог!

parts.prefix: v2;360;Akoúgetai perissótero san o Theós na thélei na syntaxiodotitheíte ... /
parts.body: Sounds more like God wants you to retire...
parts.translation: А мне кажется, что Бог хочет, чтобы ты уволился...

parts.body: Bahhh… Bahhh… I'm the king of the sheperds!
parts.job: ru|Bahhh… Bahhh… I'm the king of the sheperds!

parts.prefix: v2;30;Stamáta to! Tha ton kalésete me aftón ton tropo! /
parts.body: Stop it! You will summon him by that!
parts.job: ru|Stop it! You will summon him by that!

parts.prefix: v1;60;O Boskokrátor, sas xtizo énan ieró tópo… /
parts.body: Oh Boskokrator, I build you a sacred place…
parts.job: ru|Oh Boskokrator, I build you a sacred place…

parts.prefix: v2;90;Skáse! Den xérete ti symvaínei ston mýtho? /
parts.body: Shut up! Don’t you know what happens in the legend?
parts.job: ru|Shut up! Don’t you know what happens in the legend?

parts.prefix: v1;120;$targetfirstname, klápse moró! Eínai móno aftó! Enas mýthos! /
parts.body: $targetfirstname, you crybaby! It is only that! A legend!
parts.job: ru|$targetfirstname, you crybaby! It is only that! A legend!

rows.raw: //* The part before the ";" is the title, after it the description

parts.body: Stranger
As a folk of trade we have to accept everyone. But we don't have to trust them.
parts.translation: Мы торгуем со всеми, но не каждому доверяем.

parts.body: Familiarity
Lately, you are often seen in these Roman areas.
parts.translation: В последнее время тебя часто видно на Римской земле.

parts.body: Known Face
parts.job: ru|Known Face

parts.body: Other Romans seem to have noticed you and they speak well of you! You don't seem to be a barbarian after all.
parts.job: ru|Other Romans seem to have noticed you and they speak well of you! You don't seem to be a barbarian after all.

parts.body: Regular Visitor
Xaire, $name! Nice to see you. How are things?
parts.translation: Привет, $name! Рады тебя видеть. Как твои дела?

parts.body: Fellow Civilized Man
Ah, it's good to see that others outside of the Roman Empire can be civilized like us once in a while.
parts.translation: Ах, приятно видеть, что за пределами Римской империи могут быть цивилизованные люди, как и мы.

parts.body: Favourite Trader
Everyone here is glad to see you. Have you anything to trade? Our trading relationship has helped both of us out.
parts.translation: Мы всегда рады тебе. Есть товары для торговли?

parts.body: Friend of the Village
You are part of our village $name, we trust you now!
Respectable Ally
Congrats $name! You have earned our respect. It's difficult for outsiders to become friends of the Roman Empire, let alone respected. But YOU, you have proven yourself worthy!
parts.translation: Поздравляю $name! Вы заслужили наше уважение. Посторонним трудно стать друзьями Римской империи, не говоря уж об уважении. Но ВЫ, вы доказали, что достойны!

parts.body: One of Us
We see you now as a Roman civic $name. Maybe you weren't born as one of us, but now you can be proud to call yourself a true Roman.
parts.translation: Мы видим тебя Римлянином, $name. Может ты и не родился одним из нас, но теперь ты можешь с гордостью назвать себя Римлянин!

parts.body: Natural Leader
$name, you have gained the trust and respect of the Byzantines. They will follow you anywhere.
parts.translation: $name, вы завоевали доверие и уважение Византийцев. Они будут следовать за вами куда угодно.

parts.body: The Next Caesar
You will be the next Caesar! The sheer amount of work you have done for this village is unimaginable and we will follow you in making this world a better place. Hail $name!
parts.translation: Вы будете следующим Цезарем! Вы проделали невероятно огромную работу для этой деревни, и мы последуем за вами, чтобы сделать этот мир лучше. Славься, $name!

parts.body: Nuisance
You aren't very nice, $name. Watch your step.
parts.translation: Вы выглядите плохо, $name. Смотрите под ноги.

parts.body: Unpleasant Outsider
We accept traders, but not people like you. Be on guard.
parts.translation: Мы принимаем торговцев, но не таких как вы.

parts.body: Public Enemy
It was embarrassing of the whole Roman empire to let you alive. While you continue to enjoy to live, leave the Roman lands and never return.
parts.translation: Римская Империя не успокоится пока Вы живы!

parts.body: Apparent Barbarian
Do you not understand us? Fine, we'll try something else: BAR BAR BAR, BAR BAR, BAR BARRRR!
parts.translation: Ты нас не понимаешь? Хорошо, попробуем по-другому: ВАР ВАР ВАР, ВАР ВАР, ВАР ВАР ВАРРРРР!

parts.prefix: architect_byzantine.construction=$name! Gnorízeis óti oi Romaíoi eínai oi kalýteroi kataskevastés? /
parts.body: $name! Did you know that Romans are the best architects?
parts.translation: $name, а ты знал, что Римляне лучшие строители?

parts.prefix: architect_byzantine.construction=$name! Des pos ftiaxno ena architektoniko dimiourgima! /
parts.body: $name! Watch me build a beautiful structure.
parts.translation: $name, смотри как я строю это прекрасное здание.

parts.prefix: architect_byzantine.construction=Aftó to ktírio tha ginei poli ómorfo! /
parts.body: This building will be beautiful!

parts.prefix: architect_byzantine.construction=Den échei teliosei, allá vlépo tin omorfiá stin douleiá mou. /
parts.body: It's not done, but I already see the beauty in my work.
parts.translation: Хоть оно и не достроено, но я уже вижу, что это здание великолепно.

parts.prefix: architect_byzantine.construction=Dimioúrgo tóso entiposiakes domés. I architektoniki eínai pragmatiká i pio ómorfi morfí téchnis./
parts.body: I build such elaborate structures. Building is truly the most beautiful form of art.
parts.translation: Я умею строить такие сложные конструкции. Строительство - вот истинная форма искусства.

parts.prefix: architect_byzantine.construction=I Rómi den chtístike se mia méra, chtístike toublo me toublo. /
parts.body: Rome wasn't built in a day, it was built block by block.
parts.translation: Рим не был построен в один день, его строили веками.

parts.prefix: architect_byzantine.construction=I architektonikí mas eínai anóteri apó óla ta álla ktíria se olókliro ton kósmo. /
parts.body: Our architecture is superior to all other buildings across the world.
parts.translation: Наша архитектура самая лучшая из всех.

parts.prefix: architect_byzantine.construction=I oikodómisi me ton romaïkó trópo eínai o kalýteros trópos. /
parts.body: Building in the Roman way is the best way.

parts.prefix: architect_byzantine.construction=Sas arései to tropos kataskeuis mou? /
parts.body: Do you like my style?

parts.prefix: architect_byzantine.construction=Chtizo apo tote pou thymamai. I architektoniki échei gínei i zoí mou. /
parts.body: I've been building longer than I can remember. Building has become my life.
parts.translation: Я строил здания почти всю мою жизнь. Строительство стало частью моей жизни.

parts.body: Where does the village get these blocks from?
parts.job: ru|Where does the village get these blocks from?

parts.prefix: architect_byzantine.getResourcesForBuild=Chreiázomai ylika gia na ftiáxo tis kalýteres kataskevés! /
parts.body: I need blocks to build the best structures!
parts.job: ru|I need blocks to build the best structures!

parts.body: Every build starts with the blocks.
parts.job: ru|Every build starts with the blocks.

parts.prefix: architect_byzantine.getResourcesForBuild=Prépei na epiléxo prosektiká ta ylika o ídios. /
parts.body: I must carefully select the blocks myself.
parts.job: ru|I must carefully select the blocks myself.

parts.prefix: architect_byzantine.getResourcesForBuild=Pós metaférete tósa pollá ylika ótan ftiáchnete $name? /
parts.body: How do you carry so many blocks when you build $name?
parts.job: ru|How do you carry so many blocks when you build $name?

parts.prefix: architect_byzantine.getResourcesForBuild=To cheirótero méros tou ktiríou eínai na i metafora ton ylikon. /
parts.body: The worst part of building is getting the blocks.
parts.job: ru|The worst part of building is getting the blocks.

parts.body: Enough building! I need some wine!
parts.job: ru|Enough building! I need some wine!

parts.prefix: architect_byzantine.goDrink=Chreiázomai éna potó gia na me empnéfsei! /
parts.body: I need a drink to inspire me!
parts.job: ru|I need a drink to inspire me!

parts.prefix: architect_byzantine.goDrink=Káthe kalós oikodómos chreiázetai éna potó sto télos tis iméras. /
parts.body: Every good architect needs a drink at the end of the day.
parts.job: ru|Every good architect needs a drink at the end of the day.

parts.prefix: architect_byzantine.goDrink=I douleia mou fernei dipsa gia krasí. /
parts.body: Building makes me thirsty for wine.
parts.job: ru|Building makes me thirsty for wine.

parts.prefix: architect_byzantine.gopray=Elpízo o Theós mou dínei émpnefsi gia to epómeno ktírio mou! /
parts.body: I hope God gives me inspiration for my next building!
parts.translation: Надеюсь, Бог даст мне вдохновения на следующую постройку!

parts.prefix: architect_byzantine.gopray=Giatí o Theós me ékane architéktona? /
parts.body: Why did God make me an architect?

parts.prefix: architect_byzantine.gopray=I prosefchí eínai éna simantikó méros tou romaïkoú ktiríou. /
parts.body: Praying is an important part of Roman building.

parts.prefix: architect_byzantine.gopray=Katanoeí ta provlímata pou échoun oi architéktones. /
parts.body: He understands the troubles architects have.

parts.prefix: architect_byzantine.gorest=An den koimithó, yparxei periptosi na kano palabomara. /
parts.body: If I do not sleep, I might mess up building something.
parts.translation: Если я не высплюсь, то я могу ошибиться в постройке.

parts.prefix: architect_byzantine.gorest=Den boró na oikodomíso ótan eimai kourasmenos. /
parts.body: I cannot build when tired.
parts.translation: Я не могу строить, когда устал.

parts.prefix: architect_byzantine.gorest=Eínai dýskolo na chtizei kaneis sto skotádi. /
parts.body: It is hard to build in the dark.
I am done with building for the day.

parts.prefix: architect_byzantine.gorest=Ísos tha oneireftó ta kalýtera ktíria ston kósmo! /
parts.body: Maybe I will dream of building the world's best buildings!
parts.translation: Может, мне приснится как я строю самые лучшие в мире здания!

parts.prefix: architect_byzantine.gosocialise=Kaneís se aftó to chorió den katalavaínei ta provlímata tis oikodómisis. /
parts.body: No one in this village understands the troubles of building.
parts.translation: Никто в деревне не понимает проблемы строителей.

parts.prefix: architect_byzantine.gosocialise=Káthe architéktonas chreiázetai émpnefsi apó állous. /
parts.body: Every architect needs inspiration from others.
parts.translation: Каждый архитектор требует вдохновения от других.

parts.prefix: architect_byzantine.gosocialise=Oi architéktones chreiázontai polles apopseis gia na evdokimísoun. /
parts.body: Architects need feedback to thrive.

parts.prefix: architect_byzantine.gosocialise=Ti na skéftetai to chorió gia ta ktíriá mou? /
parts.body: What does the village think of my buildings?
parts.translation: Что деревня думает о моих постройках?

parts.prefix: armysmith_byzantine.makearrow=Káthe vélos pou káno tha vlápsei énan ochtró tis autokratorías. /
parts.body: Each arrow that I craft will harm one enemy of the Empire.
parts.translation: Каждая стрела, что я создаю, защитит нашу Империю от врагов.

parts.prefix: armysmith_byzantine.makearrow=O romaïkós stratós chreiázetai véli gia na mas prostatéfsei apó tous xénous. /
parts.body: The Roman army needs arrows to protect us from outsiders.
parts.translation: Римская армия нуждается в стрелах, чтобы защищать нас от врагов.

parts.body: The Roman army needs bows.

parts.prefix: armysmith_byzantine.makebow=Geia sou! Sas arésoun ta tóxa mou $name? /
parts.body: Hey! Do you like my bows $name?

parts.prefix: armysmith_byzantine.makebow=Káthe kaló tóxo proérchetai apó to kalýtero xýlo. /
parts.body: Every good bow comes from the best wood.
parts.translation: Каждый лук сделан из самой лучшей древесины.

parts.prefix: armysmith_byzantine.makebow=Aftó to tóxo tha nikísei polloús bárbarous. Eímai pragmatiká kýrios kataskevastís tóxon. /
parts.body: This bow will defeat many barbarians. I am truly a master bow crafter.
parts.translation: Этим луком мы победим много варваров. Я действительно мастер в своем деле.

parts.body: The Roman army needs boots!

parts.prefix: armysmith_byzantine.makesteelaxe=Den boreíte na kópsete ta déntra chorís tsekoúri! /
parts.body: You cannot chop down trees without an axe!
I craft amazing axes.

parts.prefix: armysmith_byzantine.makesteelaxe=Oi romaïkoí áxones eínai merikoí apó tous kalýterous ston kósmo! /
parts.body: Roman axes are some of the best in the world!
parts.translation: Римские топоры одни из лучших в мире!

parts.prefix: armysmith_byzantine.makesteelaxe=Oi xylourgoí chreiázontai na kánoun tous pelekeis tous. /
parts.body: The lumbermen need us to craft their axes.
How do you craft your axes $name?

parts.prefix: armysmith_byzantine.makesteelhoe=Den boreíte na doulepsetai chorís tsapes! /
parts.body: You cannot farm without farming tools!
parts.translation: Нельзя обрабатывать землю без специальных инструментов!

parts.body: I craft amazing farming tools.

parts.prefix: armysmith_byzantine.makesteelhoe=Romaïká ergaleía kalliérgeias eínai meriká apó ta kalýtera ston kósmo! /
parts.body: Roman farming tools are some of the best in the world!
parts.translation: Римские инструменты одни из лучших в мире!

parts.prefix: armysmith_byzantine.makesteelhoe=Oi agrótes chreiázontai na kataskevásoume ta ergaleía tous. /
parts.body: The farmers need us to craft their tools.

parts.prefix: armysmith_byzantine.makesteelhoe=Pós dimiourgeíte ta georgiká sas ergaleía $name? /
parts.body: How do you craft your farming tools $name?
parts.translation: Как ты делаешь свои фермерские инструменты, $name?

parts.prefix: armysmith_byzantine.makesteelpickaxe=Den boreíte na skapsetai sas chorís axina! /
parts.body: You cannot mine without a pickaxe!
I craft strong pickaxes.

parts.prefix: armysmith_byzantine.makesteelpickaxe=Oi romaïkes axines eínai merikes apó tis kalýteres ston kósmo! /
parts.body: Roman pickaxes are some of the best in the world!
parts.translation: Римские кирки одни из лучших в мире!

parts.prefix: armysmith_byzantine.makesteelpickaxe=Oi anthrakorýchoi mas chreiázontai na kataskevásoume tis axines tous. /
parts.body: The miners need us to craft their pickaxes.
How do you craft your pickaxes $name?

parts.prefix: armysmith_byzantine.makesteelshovel=Den boreíte na chtísete í na skápsete chorís éna ftyári! /
parts.body: You cannot build or dig without a shovel!
parts.translation: Без лопаты невозможно копать или строить!

parts.body: I craft durable shovels.

parts.prefix: armysmith_byzantine.makesteelshovel=Ta Romaïká ftyária eínai meriká apó ta kalýtera ston kósmo! /
parts.body: Roman shovels are some of the best in the world!
parts.translation: Римские лопаты одни из лучших в мире!

parts.prefix: armysmith_byzantine.makesteelshovel=Oi architéktones chreiázontai na kataskevásoume ta ftyária tous. /
parts.body: The architects need us to craft their shovels.
How do you craft your shovels $name?

rows.raw: //artisan_byzantine.makePainting=H Romaikh texnh einai h pio exeligmenh ston kosmo. / Roman art is the most advanced in the world.

parts.prefix: artisan_byzantine.gopray=Énas kalós technítis prépei na proséfchetai káthe forá kai lígo. /
parts.body: A good artisan needs to pray every once and a while.
parts.translation: Хорошему ремесленнику нужно молиться время от времени.

parts.prefix: artisan_byzantine.gopray=Giatí o Theós me ékane énan techníti? /
parts.body: Why did God make me an artisan?

parts.prefix: artisan_byzantine.gopray=I prosefchí eínai éna simantikó méros tis romaïkís cheirotechnías. /
parts.body: Praying is an important part of Roman crafting.
parts.translation: Мольба Богу - важнейшая часть Римского ремесла.

parts.prefix: artisan_byzantine.gopray=Katanoeí ta provlímata pou échei o technítis. /
parts.body: He understands the troubles artisan have.

parts.prefix: artisan_byzantine.gorest=Ávrio tha káno pio ómorfa prágmata! /
parts.body: Tomorrow I will craft more beautiful things!
parts.translation: Завтра я сделаю столько прекрасных вещей!

parts.prefix: artisan_byzantine.gorest=Écho kánei me ktírio gia tin iméra. /
parts.body: I am done with crafting for the day.

parts.prefix: artisan_byzantine.gorest=Ísos tha oneireftó na káno ta kalýtera toúvla tou kósmou! /
parts.body: Maybe I will dream of crafting the world's best bricks!
parts.translation: Может, мне приснится, как я делаю лучшие в мире кирпичи!

parts.prefix: artisan_byzantine.gorest=Ísos tha oneireftó na káno ta kalýtera plakákia ston kósmo! /
parts.body: Maybe I will dream of crafting the world's best tiles!
parts.translation: Может, мне приснится, как я делаю лучшую в мире кровлю!

parts.prefix: artisan_byzantine.gosocialise=Tha zitíso na do an kápoios chreiázetai na kataskeváso káti. /
parts.body: I will ask to see if anyone needs me to craft something.
parts.translation: Спрошу у народа, надо ли им чего-нибудь от меня.

parts.prefix: artisan_byzantine.gosocialise=Elpízo óti to chorió tha ektimísei ta keramídia mou. /
parts.body: I hope that the village appreciates my tiles.

parts.prefix: artisan_byzantine.gosocialise=Elpízo óti to chorió tha ektimísei ta toúvla mou. /
parts.body: I hope that the village appreciates my bricks.
Enough crafting! I need some wine!
parts.job: ru|Enough crafting! I need some wine!

parts.prefix: artisan_byzantine.goDrink=Chreiázomai éna potó gia na me empnéfsei! /
parts.body: I need a drink to inspire me!
parts.job: ru|I need a drink to inspire me!

parts.prefix: artisan_byzantine.goDrink=Káthe kalós technítis chreiázetai éna potó sto télos tis iméras. /
parts.body: Every good artisan needs a drink at the end of the day.
parts.job: ru|Every good artisan needs a drink at the end of the day.

parts.prefix: artisan_byzantine.goDrink=I cheirotechnía me kánei na dipso gia to krasí. /
parts.body: Crafting makes me thirsty for wine.
parts.job: ru|Crafting makes me thirsty for wine.

parts.prefix: artisan_byzantine.greeting=Zo kalýtera apó ólous se aftó to chorió. /
parts.body: I live better than everyone else in this village.
parts.translation: Моя жизнь гораздо лучше, чем жизнь других людей здесь.

parts.prefix: artisan_byzantine.greeting=Geia sas $name! Chreiázeste apokleistiká romaïká ylika? /
parts.body: Hello $name! Do you need any exclusive Roman blocks?
parts.translation: Приветствую, $name! Тебе нужны уникальные Римские блоки?

parts.prefix: artisan_byzantine.makeBrick=Kápoios prépei na kataskevásei ta toúvla. /
parts.body: Someone has to craft the bricks.
parts.job: ru|Someone has to craft the bricks.

parts.prefix: artisan_byzantine.makeBrick=To chorió chreiázetai na kataskeváso toúvla gia tous toíchous tous. /
parts.body: The village needs me to craft bricks for their walls.
parts.job: ru|The village needs me to craft bricks for their walls.

parts.prefix: artisan_byzantine.makeBrick=Romaïká toúvla eínai meriká apó ta pio ómorfa blok ston kósmo! /
parts.body: Roman bricks are some of the most beautiful blocks the world!
parts.job: ru|Roman bricks are some of the most beautiful blocks the world!

parts.prefix: artisan_byzantine.makeBrick=Ergazómaste píso apó tis skinés, enó oi kataskevastés paírnoun óli tin pístosi. /
parts.body: We work behind the scenes while the builders get all of the credit.
parts.job: ru|We work behind the scenes while the builders get all of the credit.

parts.prefix: artisan_byzantine.makeBrick=Oúte oi kalýteroi oikodómoi boroún na oikodomísoun chorís blok. /
parts.body: Not even the best builders can build with no blocks.
parts.job: ru|Not even the best builders can build with no blocks.

parts.prefix: artisan_byzantine.makeBrick=Poios skéftike na metatrépsei ton piló se toúvla? /
parts.body: Who thought of turning clay into bricks?
parts.job: ru|Who thought of turning clay into bricks?

parts.prefix: artisan_byzantine.makeBookshelves=Kápoios prépei na válei ta vivlía sta ráfia. /
parts.body: Someone has to put the books on the shelves.
parts.job: ru|Someone has to put the books on the shelves.

parts.prefix: artisan_byzantine.makeBookshelves=To chorió mou chreiázetai na káno tis ráfia tous. /
parts.body: The village needs me to craft their bookshelves.
parts.job: ru|The village needs me to craft their bookshelves.

parts.prefix: artisan_byzantine.makeBookshelves=Romaïká vivlía eínai meriká apó ta kalýtera pou diavázei ston kósmo! /
parts.body: Roman books are some of the best reads in the world!
parts.job: ru|Roman books are some of the best reads in the world!

parts.prefix: artisan_byzantine.makeBookshelves=Ergazómaste píso apó tis skinés, enó oi syngrafeís paírnoun óli tin pístosi. /
parts.body: We work behind the scenes while the writers get all of the credit.
parts.job: ru|We work behind the scenes while the writers get all of the credit.

parts.prefix: artisan_byzantine.makeBookshelves=Merikés forés vlépo ta vivlía prin ta válo sto ráfi, tha íthela na diaváso. /
parts.body: Sometimes I look through the books before I put them on the shelf, I wish I could read.
parts.job: ru|Sometimes I look through the books before I put them on the shelf, I wish I could read.

parts.prefix: artisan_byzantine.makeBookshelves=Poios skéftike na grápsei ta prágmata káto? /
parts.body: Who thought of writing things down?
parts.job: ru|Who thought of writing things down?

parts.body: Someone has to craft the roof tiles.
parts.job: ru|Someone has to craft the roof tiles.

parts.prefix: artisan_byzantine.makeByzantineTiles=To chorió chreiázetai na káno tis stéges tous. /
parts.body: The village needs me to craft their roofs.
parts.job: ru|The village needs me to craft their roofs.

parts.prefix: artisan_byzantine.makeByzantineTiles=Romaïká plakákia eínai meriká apó ta pio ómorfa blok ston kósmo! /
parts.body: Roman tiles are some of the most beautiful blocks the world!
parts.job: ru|Roman tiles are some of the most beautiful blocks the world!

parts.prefix: artisan_byzantine.makeByzantineTiles=Ergazómaste píso apó tis skinés, enó oi kataskevastés paírnoun óli tin pístosi. /
parts.body: We work behind the scenes while the builders get all of the credit.
parts.job: ru|We work behind the scenes while the builders get all of the credit.

parts.prefix: artisan_byzantine.makeByzantineTiles=Oúte oi kalýteroi oikodómoi boroún na oikodomísoun chorís blok. /
parts.body: Not even the best builders can build with no blocks.
parts.job: ru|Not even the best builders can build with no blocks.

parts.prefix: artisan_byzantine.makeByzantineTiles=Poios skéftike na metatrépsei ton piló se stéges? /
parts.body: Who thought of turning clay into roofs?
parts.job: ru|Who thought of turning clay into roofs?

parts.prefix: artwife_byzantine.gopray=I prosefchí eínai éna simantikó méros tis romaïkís cheirotechnías. /
parts.body: Praying is an important part of Roman crafting.

parts.prefix: artwife_byzantine.gopray=Elpízo óti o Theós me voithá na káno ta kalýtera roúcha! /
parts.body: I hope God helps me to make the best clothes!
parts.translation: Я надеюсь, что Бог поможет мне сделать лучшую одежду.

parts.prefix: artwife_byzantine.gopray=Giatí o Theós ékane ti sýzygo enós architéktona? /
parts.body: Why did God make an architect's wife?

parts.prefix: artwife_byzantine.gosocialise=O! Ékana to poukámiso tou anthrópou! /
parts.body: Oh! I made that guy's shirt!
parts.translation: О! Я сделала рубашку того парня!

parts.prefix: artwife_byzantine.gosocialise=Edó eímai gností os sýzygos tou architéktona. /
parts.body: Here, I am known as the architect's wife.
parts.translation: Здесь я известна, как жена архитектора.

parts.prefix: artwife_byzantine.gosocialise=Eímai árrostos óti eímai gností os "sýzygos tou architéktona". /
parts.body: I am sick of being known as the "architect's wife".
parts.translation: Я устала от того, что меня называют «женой архитектора».

parts.prefix: artwife_byzantine.makeclothes_byz_silk=Káno meriká apó ta kalýtera roúcha sto chorió! /
parts.body: I make some of the best clothes in the village!
parts.translation: Я делаю одну из лучших одежд в деревне.

parts.prefix: artwife_byzantine.makeclothes_byz_silk=To romantikó metáxi eínai to kalýtero ýfasma ston kósmo! /
parts.body: Roman silk is the best fabric in the world!
parts.translation: Римский шелк — лучшая ткань в мире!

parts.prefix: artwife_byzantine.makeclothes_byz_silk=To metaxotó roúcho eínai pio simantikó apó to na écheis éna fantachteró spíti. /
parts.body: Silk clothing is more important than having a fancy house.
parts.translation: Шелковая одежда важнее, чем шикарный дом.

parts.body: $name, have you worn silk before?

parts.prefix: artwife_byzantine.makeclothes_byz_silk=Óloi chreiázontai roúcha, eidiká an thélete na eíste politisménoi. /
parts.body: Everyone needs clothing, especially if you want to be civilized.
parts.translation: Всем нужно одеваться, особенно, если вы хотите быть цивилизованным.

parts.prefix: artwife_byzantine.makeclothes_byz_silk=I alithiní omorfiá den eínai se blok, i omorfiá eínai sta roúcha. /
parts.body: True beauty isn't in blocks, beauty is in clothes.
parts.translation: Настоящая красота не в блоках, настоящая красота в одежде.

parts.prefix: artwife_byzantine.makeclothes_byz_silk=Ypárchei énas lógos gia ton opoío yfaíno aftó kai óchi o sýzygós mou. /
parts.body: There's a reason why I am weaving this and not my husband.
parts.translation: Есть причина, почему это тку я, а не мой муж.

parts.prefix: artwife_byzantine.makeclothes_byz_silk=I ýfansi ton roúchon sto metáxi eínai móno gia tis pio evgeneís gynaíkes. /
parts.body: Weaving clothes in silk is only for the most noble women.
parts.translation: Изготовление одежды из шелка предназначено только для самых престижных женщин.

parts.prefix: artwife_byzantine.makeclothes_byz_silk=Chaíromai pou prépei na káno pragmatikí douleiá. /
parts.body: I am just glad that I'm having to do an actual job.
parts.translation: Я просто рада, что я должна делать настоящую работу.

parts.prefix: artwife_byzantine.makeclothes_byz_wool=Káno meriká apó ta kalýtera mallina roucha sto chorió! /
parts.body: I make some of the best wool clothes in the village!
parts.translation: Я делаю одну из лучших одежд из шерсти в деревне.

parts.prefix: artwife_byzantine.makeclothes_byz_wool=Oraía endymasía eínai pio simantikó apó ó, ti échei éna fantachteró spíti. /
parts.body: Nice clothing is more important than having a fancy house.
parts.translation: Хорошая одежда важнее, чем шикарный дом.

parts.prefix: artwife_byzantine.makeclothes_byz_wool=$name, échete forései to mallí sas prin? /
parts.body: $name, have you worn wool before?

parts.prefix: artwife_byzantine.makeclothes_byz_wool=I alithiní omorfiá den eínai se blok, i omorfiá eínai sta roúcha. /
parts.body: True beauty isn't in blocks, beauty is in clothes.
parts.translation: Настоящая красота не в блоках, настоящая красота в одежде.

parts.prefix: artwife_byzantine.makeclothes_byz_wool=Óloi chreiázontai roúcha, eidiká an thélete na eíste politisménoi. /
parts.body: Everyone needs clothing, especially if you want to be civilized.
parts.translation: Всем нужно одеваться, особенно, если вы хотите быть цивилизованным.

parts.prefix: artwife_byzantine.makeclothes_byz_wool=Ypárchei énas lógos gia ton opoío yfaíno aftó kai óchi o sýzygós mou. /
parts.body: There's a reason why I am weaving this and not my husband.
parts.translation: Есть причина, почему это тку я, а не мой муж.

parts.prefix: artwife_byzantine.makeclothes_byz_wool=Den boreí káthe gynaíka na yfánei me mallí. /
parts.body: Not every woman can weave with wool.
parts.translation: Не каждая женщина может ткать из шерсти.

parts.prefix: artwife_byzantine.makeclothes_byz_wool=Chaíromai pou prépei na káno pragmatikí douleiá. /
parts.body: I am just glad that I'm having to do an actual job.
parts.translation: Я просто рада, что я должна делать настоящую работу.

parts.prefix: artwife_byzantine.DeliverGoodsHousehold=Pragmata opws auto einai ta mona pou mporw na kanw. /
parts.body: Things like this are the only things I can do here.
parts.job: ru|Things like this are the only things I can do here.

parts.prefix: artwife_byzantine.GetHouseTHResources=Epitelous o syzygos mou metefere ta agatha opws tou eipa. /
parts.body: My husband has finally delivered his resources like I told him.
parts.job: ru|My husband has finally delivered his resources like I told him.

parts.prefix: artwife_byzantine.getGoodsHousehold=Óra na frontízo tin oikogéneiá mou. /
parts.body: Time to take care of my family.

parts.body: Do I have to talk to the common folk?

parts.translation: Это строение принесет пользу моей деревне.

parts.translation: Красота - наблюдать за тем как твоя деревня становится богаче.

parts.translation: Это моя работа - убеждаться, что все будет построено правильно.

parts.translation: Мои архитекторы обычно работают хорошо, но я должен присматривать за ними.

parts.body: Time to become a strong man!
parts.job: ru|Time to become a strong man!

parts.body: Time to play "soldier".
parts.job: ru|Time to play "soldier".
